attorneys.name: Bayleigh Adams
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Bayleigh was born and raised in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. She received her undergraduate degree from Oklahoma State University and her Juris Doctorate from Oklahoma City University School of Law. While at OSU Bayleigh spent her summers working for the Oklahoma County District Attorney’s Office as a legal volunteer. As a legal volunteer she assisted on juvenile, felony, civil, and diversion court cases.

Bayleigh continued to volunteer at the DA’s office through law school. During her second year as a law student she was sworn in as a Licensed Legal Intern for the District Attorney’s Office where she gained valuable experience assigned to the Felony Unit and the Special Victims Unit /Sex Crime Unit. During her internship she was able to appear on behalf of the state in court, plea cases, represent the state in preliminary hearings, argue motions, and prepare cases for jury trial. Most importantly serving as an intern allowed Bayleigh to make lasting connections within Oklahoma County District Court in addition to learning from experienced prosecutors and judges.

In 2016, Bayleigh joined Quillian Law where she represents clients in Federal, State and Municipal courts. Bayleigh is admitted in Federal Court for the Western District of Oklahoma. She is also a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association, Oklahoma County Bar Association, the Oklahoma Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, and the National Cannabis Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Gale Allison
attorneys.practice_type: Estate and Trust Litigation Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Attorney/Director and Estate, Elder care & Family Mediator

Gale Allison has four decades of estate, business and tax experience as an estate and trust lawyer. She is also an attorney mediator. Her law and mediation practices focus entirely on matters of probate and estate administration, estate taxes, asset protection, elder law issues, estate and business succession planning and estate litigation. Practicing law in Tulsa Oklahoma, she is also available to mediate nationwide.

Her dispute mediation certifications (Mediating the Litigated Case; Elder Care Mediation) are from Pepperdine University School of Law’s Straus Institute for Dispute Resolution:. She holds a Bachelor of Arts in English from the University of Georgia, a Doctor of Jurisprudence from the University of Tennessee, and a Master of Laws in Taxation from Emory University. She is admitted to the bar in Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Georgia. In addition to all courts in those three states, Ms. Allison is admitted to practice before the U.S. Tax Court, the 4th, 5th, 6th, and 10th Circuit Courts of Appeals and the U.S. Supreme Court.

She served as an Assistant General Counsel for Litigation for the federal government and an Estate and Gift Tax Attorney for the IRS before entering private practice. As an Adjunct Professor, she taught estate tax law at Northeastern State University and jurisprudence at the University of Tennessee. She practiced estate law as a partner in two large law firms before moving to Oklahoma and founding The Allison Firm, PLLC in 1996. She limited that boutique firm’s practice to matters of estates, wills, trusts, asset protection, estate and business succession planning, estate-related tax matters, and litigating or settling disputes in these practice areas. In 2017, she merged her law practice into Schaffer Herring, PLLC, where she serves as an Attorney/Director. At that time, she also merged her mediation practice into DRC (Dispute Resolution Consultants) where she is an attorney / mediator.

Ms. Allison is a member of the Tulsa County Bar Association, the Oklahoma Bar Association, the State Bar of Georgia, the Tennessee Bar Association, and the American Bar Association. Her American, Oklahoma and Tulsa Bar memberships include the Alternative Dispute Resolution and Litigation Sections of each and she is a past chair of the Oklahoma Bar Association Estate Planning, Probate and Trust Section. Additionally, she is a member of the Estate Planning Forum of Tulsa and Tulsa Title and Probate Lawyers Association.

Active in many community and charitable groups, she serves on the St. John Health System Institutional Review Board and the Advisory Board of Purview (life care management). A strong supporter of veterans’ causes, Gale Allison speaks nationwide on every facet of estate, trust, and related tax and family matters to continuing education professionals, business groups and for general public education.

attorneys.bio:
James is an experienced litigator and trial attorney, with a track record of successfully representing clients across a diverse array of practice areas. In his career, James has practiced in the areas of commercial litigation, probate (contested and uncontested), family and domestic disputes, insurance defense, personal injury, criminal defense, property disputes, and more. He began his career as an assistant district attorney, before moving into private practice. James enjoys leveraging his broad experience to develop individual solutions to the problems his clients are facing. Indeed, James sees the practice of law as a vehicle for helping clients find creative solutions to their problems. Born in Oklahoma but raised around the country, James earned his Juris Doctorate from the University of Tulsa, where he earned membership in the coveted Order of Barristers for his skill as an oral advocate.

He is also a graduate of Oklahoma Christian University, where he earned his Bachelor of Science, cum laude, in political science.

When he is not in the office or in the courtroom, James enjoys spending his free time with his wife and child. He enjoys camping and is a voracious reader.

attorneys.name: Benjamin Barker
attorneys.practice_type: Felony and Misdemeanor Criminal Defense Lawyers in Enid, OK
attorneys.bio:
Ben Barker represents clients in all manner of litigation across the State of Oklahoma, with a primary focus on criminal defense and family law in Northwest Oklahoma. Ben is licensed to practice in all Oklahoma State Courts, the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Oklahoma, and the courts of the Cherokee Nation. A member of the Oklahoma Family Law Section, and the Oklahoma Criminal Defense Lawyer's Association, Ben's criminal defense work has been featured in national and international new publications, including the Washington Post, New York Daily News, and the Daily Mail (UK). He has also been invited to appear on the NBC television show "Dr. Phil" in connection with his criminal defense work.

Ben is a graduate of Oklahoma State University (2010) and the University of Oklahoma College of Law (2013). An active member of the Garfield County Bar Association, Ben has served as Law Day Committee Chairman since 2017 and represented Garfield County as a delegate at the 2018 OBA Annual Meeting. In 2018, Ben received the Garfield County Bar Association Outstanding Young Lawyer Award.

attorneys.name: John Berry
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
John Berry is a litigation attorney focusing on oil and gas-related matters, environmental issues, real property disputes, and general litigation before state and federal courts. As an associate attorney with the firm, John represents producers, operators, working interest owners, mineral owners, landowners, and additional parties in a wide range of oil and gas issues.

John graduated summa cum laude from Oklahoma City University School of Law in 2024, ranking in the top 5 of his graduating class. While attending law school, John earned the CALI Award for the highest grade in a law school course in Oil & Gas Law, Oil & Gas Regulation, Secured Transactions, Trial Practice, Civil Practice & Procedure, Evidence, and Legal Research & Writing. John served as staff editor of the Oklahoma City University Law Review, competed on the ABA Appellate Advocacy Moot Court team, and was treasurer for the Energy Law Association. John was awarded the Judge Alfred P. Murrah Sr. Outstanding Academic Performance Award and the Charles Nesbitt Energy Law Award for these academic achievements.

John and his wife currently reside in Oklahoma City.

attorneys.practice_type: Litigation - Trial & Appellate Practice – State & Federal Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
I am the attorney that other attorneys turn to when the case and issue prove difficult – in almost any area. Generally, my practice involves business transaction analysis and, if necessary, trial and appellate litigation. My work involves contract formation and enforcement, employment issues, tax assistance and controversies, computer law, commercial debt collection, professional licensure assistance, real estate contracts and disputes, oil and gas issues, environmental law, criminal appeals and probate and guardianship matters. I have an American Indian law component to my practice that involves gaming, economic development and Tribal government law.

Prior to entering the legal profession, I was a computer programmer for various companies in the Oklahoma City area, including the Oklahoma Supreme Court, Dobson Communications Corporation and Star Building Systems. During law school, I was honored to be a student law clerk for the Honorable Justice Ralph Hodges of the Oklahoma Supreme Court.

attorneys.name: Meg Bloom
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Meg Bloom received her undergraduate degree in Health Education and Promotion from Oklahoma State University and her law degree from the University of Oklahoma with a certificate in American Indian Law. While at law school, Meg served as the president of the Criminal Law Association and as an Assistant Executive Editor for the American Indian Law Review. Ms. Bloom has a published article in the American Indian Law Review Journal discussing the history and effects of state criminal jurisdiction over tribal land and is certified in peacemaking.

During her time at the University of Oklahoma, Ms. Bloom interned with the Attorney General’s Office in the Criminal Appeals Unit and clerked for Judge Musseman at the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals. These experiences allowed Ms. Bloom to gain an insider’s view of judicial reasoning and the intricacies of courtroom procedure, equipping her with a comprehensive understanding of criminal law from both the appellate and judicial perspectives.

With a proven ability to analyze complex legal issues, write persuasively, and navigate the nuances of courtroom dynamics, Ms. Bloom is poised to bring strategic insight and dedication to her legal practice. She is passionate about delivering high-quality legal advocacy and seeks to continue making an impact in the field of criminal law.

attorneys.name: Taylor Brown
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Taylor Brown is a family law attorney with a strong background in litigation, negotiation, and advocacy. A graduate of The University of Oklahoma College of Law, she began her legal career as a Judge Advocate General (JAG) Officer in the United States Air Force, practicing military law with a focus on both prosecution and defense. She uses this experience to shape her thoughtful, client-centered approach to advocacy today.

Today, Taylor brings that comprehensive experience to Ball Morse Lowe’s family law team in Oklahoma City. Taylor’s military background gives her unique insight into the intricacies of military life, the military legal system, and the unique challenges military members and families may face. Whether representing a service member, veteran, or military spouse, she strives to guide clients through some of life’s most difficult transitions with clarity, confidence, and integrity. Her practice covers a wide range of matters, including divorce, child custody, child support, paternity, guardianship, and victim’s protective orders. She also draws on her military background to assist service members and their families when criminal or administrative matters overlap with family law issues.

Clients value Taylor’s thoughtful approach to complex family dynamics and her ability to balance compassion with vigorous representation both inside and outside the courtroom.

Originally from Oklahoma, Taylor earned her undergraduate degree in History from Oklahoma City University, where she developed her advocacy skills through competitive debate and later served as an assistant coach. Her lifelong dedication to persuasive communication and client-centered advocacy continues to shape her practice today.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Air and Space Commendation Medal

Organizational Excellence Award

Global War on Terrorism Medal

Air Force Training Ribbon

National Defense Service Medal

attorneys.name: Austin Browning
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Raised in rural Dibble Oklahoma, Austin knew at an early age he wanted to be involved in law and politics. Austin attended Southwestern Oklahoma State University where he was a Cum Laude honors graduate, president of the criminal justice club, and scholar of the year in 2017 for both the Political and Social Science departments.

From there he attended Oklahoma City School of Law, where he was awarded membership into the Board of Barristers for outstanding trial advocacy, and was also a contributing editor to the Oklahoma County Judges Bench Book.

Austin began his professional career as a licensed legal intern in the Cleveland County District Attorney’s Office where he was assigned to a felony docket, assisted with misdemeanor as well as juvenile deprived cases. He then served District 6 in Grady and Caddo Counties as an Assistant District Attorney and handled a plethora of different cases including criminal and juvenile matters, tried multiple cases to a jury and received convictions. Including 3 counts of life in an aggravated child abuse case.

Austin most recently worked as an Assistant Tribal Prosecutor for the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma where he handled felony and juvenile deprived cases, led training for Lighthorse officers & observed numerous forensic interviews. Austin’s trial experience includes achieving a conviction in one of the first jury trials held by a sovereign native nation since the McGirt decision was made by the U.S. Supreme Court.

attorneys.name: Courtney Bru
attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Employers rely on Courtney Bru to provide effective representation on state and federal labor and employment law matters. She works with employers, HR personnel and managers to develop policies and practices designed to reduce risk, liability and protect against employment-related claims. A significant portion of her experience includes:

· Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA)

· Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

· Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

· Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)

· National Labor Relations Act (NLRA)

· Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964

· Wage and hour issues arising under various state laws

· Discrimination and retaliation issues arising under various state laws

In addition to her employment practice, she has consistently devoted a portion of her practice to commercial and civil litigation in state and federal trial and appellate courts.

Prior to joining Doerner, Courtney worked with Littler Mendelson, one of the world's largest labor and employment law firms. Raised in a small town in south Alabama, and having counseled clients both big and small, Courtney believes that legal advice is not a "one size fits all" proposition. She seeks to provide tailored and targeted advice to address an employer's legal needs in a manner consistent with its culture and goals.

attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Law Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Isaiah N. Brydie, Esquire, returned to Tulsa after attending Law School at the University of Oklahoma to establish his business law practice just a few miles away from where he grew up. He is a distinguished graduate from Thee Jackson State University, an Historically Black University where Mr. Brydie was honored as a McNair Scholar and Thurgood Marshall Scholarship Fellow. While in law school, Mr. Brydie courses focused on business law, business transaction, contract drafting and review, administrative law, and mergers and acquisitions.

Mr. Brydie's Tulsa community ties run deep. Growing up in North Tulsa, Mr. Brydie attended Emerson Elementary, played at Owen Park, learned about the history of his community - from Black Wall Street to the present - and dreamed about how he would contribute to the civic and business life in his hometown as a lawyer. At Booker T. Washington High School, Mr. Brydie was President of his school's chapter of a fraternal and mentorship organization, Men of Power. The seeds of many of his life-long mentoring relationships and friendships in Tulsa were planted there."

Mr. Byrdie is a Star Wars fan and his hobbies include reading, hunting, fishing, and fitness.

attorneys.name: Michael Burrage
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Litigation Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Michael Burrage is a Co-Founder of Whitten Burrage. Michael became the first Native American Federal Judge when he was appointed by President William Jefferson Clinton in 1994. In 2016, he was inducted into the Oklahoma Hall of Fame and in 2013, the University of Oklahoma College of Law inducted Michael into the Order of the Owl Hall of Fame. Michael is an inductee of the prestigious fellowship of the American College of Trial Lawyers. Michael has been selected as one of Oklahoma's Top 10 Attorneys by Super Lawyers Magazine.

Michael earned his Juris Doctorate from the University of Oklahoma, where he served as editor of the Oklahoma Law Review and was a member of the Order of the Coif before graduating with honors in 1974.

Michael began his career as a partner in the law firm of Stamper & Burrage from 1974 to 1994. In 1977, he was voted Outstanding Young Lawyer in Oklahoma and served as a member of the Board of Governors from 1984 through 1986. Michael served as president of the Oklahoma Bar Association in 1990 and was awarded the Neil E. Bogan Professionalism Award in 1991.

He subsequently served as a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Oklahoma from 1994 to 2001. Michael also sat by designation of the Chief on approximately 40 cases for the United States Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit. In 2011, he returned to private practice and enjoys a success career litigating in various areas of the law.

Michael served as Chair of the Oklahoma State Committee from 2008-2009 for the American College of Trial Lawyers and in 2008, was selected as one of the Top Attorneys in Oklahoma by Oklahoma Magazine. He is a member of the Oklahoma and American Bar Associations, a fellow of the American Bar Foundation and is a member of the Oklahoma Supreme Court Committee for Civil Jury Instructions. Michael lectures at a variety of Continuing Legal Education seminar programs.

attorneys.bio:
Joe Byars is an experienced litigator and trial attorney with 35 years of experience assisting clients in Oklahoma, Arkansas and Texas with complex legal disputes. Joe has extensive experience litigating a range of matters including complex business and commercial cases, probate estate and trust disputes, employment claims, major personal injury cases, real estate matters, and partner disputes. Joe earned a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration from Baylor University in 1985 and his Juris Doctor at the University of Arkansas in 1988. Joe is admitted to practice in all state courts throughout Arkansas, Oklahoma and Texas, as well as several U.S. district courts, the U.S. Supreme Court, and the U.S. Court of Appeals.

attorneys.name: John P. Cannon
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
John is a husband, father, soldier, and counselor.

He is dedicated to helping you and your family through the difficult situation you are facing. He will Fight for Your Rights, while always keeping you informed. It is important to have competent and caring counsel by your side throughout your case.

John’s experience and reputation will be an asset to you during this difficult time. With Cannon & Associates, you will never have to make a decision without all the available information and you will always understand the process at hand and ahead. Our firm hopes to help you and wishes you and yours the best.

Attorney John P. Cannon graduated from the University of Kansas with a BA in English Literature. After finishing his undergraduate degree, he did a clerkship in Washington, D.C. for the United States Senate. He attended Oklahoma City University College of Law where he clerked for the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals.

attorneys.name: Blake Cantrell
attorneys.practice_type: Business and Commercial Transactions Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Blake Cantrell is a business and commercial transactions attorney with over a decade of experience in a variety of corporate areas. Blake’s career has primarily been focused on corporate governance and transactional matters in his capacity as an entrepreneur and start-up business owner.

After launching and rapidly scaling his first entrepreneurial venture, a food delivery company based in Norman, he successfully negotiated the acquisition and sale of his company to GrubHub, Inc. Later, he served as General Counsel and Chief Executive Officer of a multi-unit retail business based in OKC, overseeing the expansion of the business to 6 locations across Oklahoma, and managing 70+ employees.

During his time as General Counsel, he also established the company as an FTC-compliant franchisor, with multiple franchisee entities operating under the corporate brand. Most recently, Blake has the distinct honor of guiding young future entrepreneurs in his capacity as a Professor of Entrepreneurship & Law at the University of Oklahoma.

Blake and his wife Devon met at TU Law and recently celebrated the arrival of their first son. After living several years in Boulder, CO, Blake and his wife often visit Colorado to hike in the summers and snowboard in the winters. In his free time, Blake enjoys traveling, playing with their Bernese Mountain dogs, boating on Grand Lake, golfing, and attending Oklahoma Sooners football games in Norman.

attorneys.name: Devon Cantrell
attorneys.practice_type: Oil & Gas Title Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Born and raised in Long Beach, California, Devon graduated from the University of California, Davis, in 2006 with a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and History. She graduated from the University of Tulsa College of Law in 2011. While in law school, Devon interned at a major independent exploration and production company where she discovered a love for oil and gas law.

After law school, Devon began her career practicing at a law firm in Boulder, Colorado, and moved back to Oklahoma in 2015, focusing her practice on oil and gas operations in Oklahoma, Wyoming and Colorado. She has significant experience with complex oil and gas issues, including State and Federal drilling units, Restricted Indian lands, riparian rights and accretion of rivers, subdivision/townsite ownership and sophisticated production schemes.

Since 2011, Devon has been in the private sector where her practice focuses on oil and gas title examination, due diligence and curative work for operations in Oklahoma, Wyoming and Colorado. Devon also practices business entity formation, probate, and family law. She currently volunteers with the Oklahoma Innocence Project. In her free time, Devon enjoys traveling with her husband, running and surfing when she can make her way to the beaches on the coast.

attorneys.name: Ryan Childress
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Ryan Childress is an attorney in Tulsa who came from humble beginnings. The son of an auto mechanic, Ryan had to work very hard in life to earn scholarships to pay for his education. In high school is where Ryan first shined bright. He worked, played tennis, maintained a 4.0+ GPA, graduated in the top 10 of his class, was twice-elected President of Key Club (a high school arm of Kiwanis that aims at public service for needs in the community), and was class president all four years of high school. The last three years, he ran unopposed. It was Ryan’s personal approach to his peers that separated him from the rest. Everyone matters, and he did everything he could to show each person that he was a sincere leader.

Athletically, Ryan was a star tennis player before becoming an attorney. He was the only four-year varsity letterman when he graduated. He was conference champion numerous times in both singles and doubles.

Ryan first learned the value of hard work in high school on the Speech and Debate team. After qualifying to nationals twice, and being ranked one of the top 25 debaters in the nation in overall points accumulated by the National Forensics League, Ryan earned a debate scholarship to attend Missouri State University. Beyond debate, Ryan earned a full academic scholarship to assist in becoming an attorney as well as several leadership scholarships.

At Missouri State, Ryan truly shined. He majored in Public Relations with minors in Technical Writing and Public Law (a minor designed to prepare a student for law school to become an attorney). Outside the classroom, Ryan worked multiple jobs while holding numerous leadership roles on campus. Those roles include, but are not limited to, a Resident Assistant, Executive Board of the Student Government Association, Tutor, Assistant Director of Forensics at Parkview High School, and he was even appointed by then Governor Roy Blunt to serve as Student Governor on the Missouri State University System Board of Governors. This was the highest leadership position on campus.

After his eight-year commitment to high school speech and debate, Ryan put his experience on paper when he wrote, “The Super-Novice File: A Beginner’s Guide to Policy Debate.” The National Forensics League (now National Speech & Debate Association) was so thrilled with the work they made it their official guide to policy debate for the entire country for beginning coaches and students.

Ms. Christie is an attorney originally from Mission Hills, Kansas. While attending Texas Christian University on a merit scholarship, Ms. Christie earned her Bachelor of Arts in International Communications with minors in both Business and French.

Finally pursuing her passion for the law, Ms. Christie attended the Oklahoma City University School of Law on a merit scholarship, where she was a was a clinical student with OCU LAW's Oklahoma Innocence Clinic, where she examined wrongful convictions in Oklahoma through investigating current cases with credible evidence of factual innocence.

Before joining Swain Law Group, Ms. Christie worked for a prominent criminal defense attorney in Oklahoma City for over ten years. During that time, Ms. Christie gained experience in all stages of the criminal process for various misdemeanor and felony cases ranging from arraignment to dismissal or jury acquittal. Additionally, Ms. Christie has been involved in drafting successful appeals in front of the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals and the Oklahoma Supreme Court.

Ms. Christie is a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association and is licensed to practice in all Oklahoma State courts.

Ms. Christie loves spending time in nature and being together with her husband and two dogs. She loves to garden and cook.

attorneys.name: Monica Collison Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
When you are facing a difficult divorce or family law matter, having dedicated legal representation on your side can provide you with much-needed guidance throughout your case. Monica Miller Collison is a compassionate Senior Associate Attorney with Stange Law Firm. Based in our Oklahoma City, OK office, she is prepared to represent clients throughout Oklahoma County and surrounding areas.

Monica attended the University of Oklahoma School of Law, where she earned her Juris Doctor in May of 1999. While in law school, she was inducted into the Phi Delta Phi Legal Honorary Fraternity and selected as the law student representative for OU’s distinguished, interdisciplinary training program on child abuse and neglect. She also achieved Dean’s Honor Roll and an Academic Achievement Award in Trial Techniques for her litigation skills. Additionally, she assisted Professor Robert S. Spector as a family law student intern and clerked for the late Honorable Glenn Dale Carter in the juvenile and family law arena. Prior to law school, Monica received a Bachelor of Science in Family Relations and Child Development from Oklahoma State University.

Prior to joining the Oklahoma City divorce and family lawyers at Stange Law Firm, Monica most recently served as an attorney and consultant at her own practice in the OKC metro area. Monica also founded the Oklahoma Rural Association in 2017, where she continues to provide oversight in the areas of economic development, energy, rural education and healthcare. Earlier work experience includes serving as the President and CEO of an Oklahoma based insurance company, owner of her own consulting and legal firm, and executive director, general counsel, and legislative liaison for Oklahoma’s largest domestic insurance and non-profit organization. Monica’s extensive professional experience prepares her to represent you in your family law matter.

In addition to the Oklahoma and Oklahoma County Bar Associations, Monica has been involved with Leadership Oklahoma, SALT Program, Downtown Edmond Business Association, and the Oklahoma Automobile Insurance Plan. In her spare time, Monica enjoys traveling, spending time at her family farm and supporting her children in their sporting activities, academic pursuits and performances on stages across the country.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements

attorneys.name: Stephanie Kaye Corbett
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Stephanie was born and raised in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. Her desire to become a lawyer started at a very young age, when she would play "courtroom" in her family's garage. Stephanie attended college at Oklahoma City University, where she obtained a Bachelor of Arts degree in both Criminal Justice-Law Enforcement and Sociology with a minor in Spanish. Following graduation, she worked as a docket clerk at the law firm of Merritt and Associates and began law school one year later. Stephanie graduated from Oklahoma City University School of Law in 2005. After graduation, she worked as an Associate Attorney at Zlotogura and Zlotogura, where her practice was focused on worker's compensation. In 2007, Stephanie began working at The Law Office of Aimee J. Treece, as a full time in-house attorney for Liberty Mutual Insurance Company. As an attorney for Liberty Mutual Insurance Company, Stephanie's practice focused solely on civil litigation in the areas of personal injury, automobile liability, wrongful death, premises liability, construction defects, and various other matters.

Over the years, Stephanie has handled many cases from start to finish, and everything in between. She has extensive experience in motions practice, depositions, and mediations. In addition, Stephanie has tried numerous cases, before both judge and jury, in various counties all across the state of Oklahoma.

Stephanie currently lives in Oklahoma City with her family, which brings her much joy. She loves spending time with family and friends and doing anything that requires being outdoors. In her spare time, Stephanie volunteers as a tutor and mentor to students in the Oklahoma City Public Schools system.

Lily is mother to a beautiful boy and a wife to her supportive husband. At Lily Debrah Cruickshank & Associates, PLLC we understand that going through a divorce is one of the most life altering situations anyone can be involved in, thereby we do all we can to make the experience as easy as possible by providing our clients with individual representation based on their own individual situation.

Lily Debrah Cruickshank attended Broken Arrow High School. She graduated from Oklahoma Christian University in Edmond with a political science degree and a minor in history. At Oklahoma Christian, Lily was very involved; she was a member of the President's leadership council. Lily worked in the admissions office where she was a tour guide for prospective students. Lily Attended the University of Oklahoma, College of Law. While there, she served on the dean's counsel as well as served as legal intern for the Dean of the law School, Dean Coats as well as Professor Randall Coyne. Lily achieved an amjur, which is the highest grade in the class for Criminal Law. Lily was also awarded the coveted Kerr McGee Scholar, which included a scholarship as well an internship at the legal department for Kerr McGee Corporation.

Lily practices in the areas of family law, divorce, custody, child support, adoptions, post decree modifications, contested divorce, uncontested divorce, waiver divorce, paternity actions, annulments, legal separations, and pre decree modifications. She also practices in the area of estate planning, wills, trusts, advance directives for healthcare, guardianships, as well as personal injury, dog bites, auto accidents, truck accidents, aviation accidents, property damage, and amusement park injuries.

Lily provides her clients with client centered representation. She is in tune with her clients expectations and does not make false empty promises. Lily is mother to a beautiful boy and a wife to her supportive husband. At Lily Debrah Cruickshank & Associates, PLLC we understand that going through a divorce is one of the most life altering situations anyone can be involved in, thereby we do all we can to make the experience as easy as possible by providing our clients with individual representation based on their own individual situation.

attorneys.name: Diana Cupps
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Diana the Lawyer is who you want in your corner.

Diana began her adult life in South Texas as a soldier in the U. S. Army. While in the Army, she served in Germany and on bases in the United States and trained as a medical laboratory technician.

Upon honorable discharge from the military, Diana attended Central Texas College, earning her associate degree in 2002. Diana holds a nursing degree from the Carolyn McKelvey Moore School of Nursing at the University of Arkansas, which she used to focus on emergency room nursing for six years. She obtained certifications in Trauma Nursing, Pediatric and Adult Cardiac Life Support, Neonatal Resuscitation Program, and earned the title of Certified Emergency Nurse. She also earned a bachelor’s degree in liberal studies with a concentration in psychology and sociology from Oklahoma State University in Tulsa.

Diana earned her law degree from the University of Tulsa College of Law, where she was an active member of the Health & Medicine Society, the Public Interest Board, the Immigration Law Society, the Resources, Energy, and Environmental Law Society, and the Phi Alpha Delta Law Fraternity.

Her strong medical history and depth of experience and knowledge provides a unique advantage in helping with medical malpractice claims and catastrophic injury cases. She brings a multitude of medical, military, leadership, advocacy, negotiation, and customer service skills to her legal profession.

Diana is fluent in Spanish.

attorneys.bio:
For over 30 years and currently, Mr. DeClerck's practice has been and still is devoted to assisting and counseling people with legal issues and problems occurring in daily living. His legal expertise includes life and estate planning, including helping clients' plan their estates and assisting children and beneficiaries receive what their loved ones who passed away intended for them to receive through will and trust litigation. Other aspects of his practice include family law, contracts, agricultural and mineral sales and leasing, right of ways and easements, and litigation involving personal injuries.

Tim DeClerck was born in Enid, Oklahoma, on November 15, 1956. He received a Bachelor of Arts Degree in journalism/public relations from the University of Oklahoma in 1980 and a Juris Doctorate Degree from the University of Oklahoma in 1983.

Mr. DeClerck was admitted to the Bar in Oklahoma in 1983 and is admitted to practice before the United States District Court for the Western District of Oklahoma and the United States Supreme Court. He is a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association and Garfield County, Oklahoma, Bar Association.

Active in his community, Mr. DeClerck is a member of the Enid Noon AMBUCS club, a founder of the Tour de Trike Tour and Criterium, an annual bicycle tour and race in Enid, a long time member of the Tri-State Music Festival board, and is member of the Denny Price YMCA board. He is a member of St. Gregory the Great Catholic Church and is currently a member of the Parish Finance Committee.

attorneys.name: Jake Denne
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Jake Denne is a dedicated attorney who discovered his passion for law and justice at a young age while growing up in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

In 2018, he became a first-generation college graduate after earning his Bachelor’s Degree in Political Science from the University of Arkansas. He went on to earn his Juris Doctor from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2022. While attending OU Law, Jake developed strong foundations in legal theory and practice. Jake passed the Uniform Bar Exam shortly after earning his Juris Doctor, and is licensed to practice in every jurisdiction in Oklahoma.

Throughout his academic career, Jake demonstrated a commitment to excellence and a passion for advocating for others. While attending the University of Arkansas, he was a member of the Associated Student Government and a recruitment chairman for the Sigma Phi Epsilon fraternity. He was also a member of the National Political Science Honor Society, and graduated with a 4.0 GPA in the field. From 2019 to 2022, Jake was the sole recipient of the prestigious Cherokee Nation Foundation Businesses Scholarship due to his advocacy for the needs of underprivileged Native American communities in Oklahoma. While attending the OU Law, Jake sat as a member of both the Federalist Society and Constitutional Society, and received specialized, hands-on training in developing the attorney-client relationship.

Jake’s legal career has given him a uniquely diverse set of skills. He began his professional work in the fields of Criminal and Family law, which gave him the opportunity to help those in his community when they were at their most vulnerable. He then practiced Civil Defense—specializing in the complex field of Civil Rights—which gave him the opportunity to develop professional discipline and a strong work ethic. Now, he proudly has the privilege to represent individuals across Oklahoma who have been treated unjustly. With a strong ethical foundation and a commitment to ongoing professional growth, Jake is poised to continue developing as a trusted advocate for his clients.

attorneys.name: Gregory James Denney
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Gregory James Denney was born in 1970 in Springfield, Missouri attended high school and graduated in the class of 1989 in Joplin, Missouri. He then attended Missouri Southern State College, now Missouri Southern State University, and graduated with a Bachelor's of Science and and Associate's of Science in 1993. He then furthered his education at the University of Tulsa College of Law, resulting in his Juris Doctorate in 1998. Greg has been a practicing lawyer in good standing for nineteen years.

He opened Greg Denney and Associates, PC out of Law School, And over the years started Denney & Stinnett, PLLC. During this time, Greg continually owned and operated multiple law offices spanning Tulsa and Creek Counties up until 2015. Denney & Stinnett employed up to seven lawyers during its tenure, resulting in millions of dollars in settlements and verdicts for their clients. Since 2015, Greg has owned Greg Denney Law, PLLC, Where he has been awarded multiple million dollar settlements and seven-figure large verdicts, one of the most recent being ten million and two-hundred fifty thousand dollars ($10,250,000) this April 2017.

He has been the prevailing party in numerous Supreme Court and Oklahoma Court of Civil Appeals cases as well. Greg has been recognized by many well-known publishers in and around the Tulsa and Oklahoma City areas, including but not limited to: the Wall Street Journal, the Tulsa world and the Oklahoma Bar Journal, not to mention many media and news agencies including KTUL and Fox News Tulsa. Greg is also a current and continuing member of the Oklahoma Trial Lawyers Association, The Association of Trial Lawyers of America, the Oklahoma Association of Justice. Greg is admitted to the Oklahoma Bar Association, and is currently licensed to practice in state and federal courts where he is admitted to the Northern District of Oklahoma and the Eastern District of Oklahoma.

Greg is a proud father of five children, Kasey, Katelyn, Chase, Jack, and Walter Denney. He has successfully coached each of his children's teams in basketball, and continues to do so this year, as he is head coach for Jack's team in Bixby, Oklahoma. Greg is a firm believer of Jesus Christ, and he and his family are active members of Jenks First Baptist Church, where they have been attending for approximately 13 years. His wife Kristina and the staff currently run the operations of Greg Denney Law, PLLC, with Kristina being the office manager and being by his side since the inception of his career.

Greg's interests include being a family man, weight-lifting and exercise, gardening and landscaping, and vintage and new sports cars. He is currently a member of Daily Driven Exotics of Tulsa, where he sponsors his 2017 Porsche 911 Turbo.

attorneys.name: Jacob D. Diesselhorst
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Jacob is one of the most respected, aggressive and well-thought of trial attorneys in Oklahoma litigation today. Opposing counsel, judges and colleagues alike recognize Jacob's passionate and aggressive prosecution of cases on behalf of his clients. Jacob takes great pride in representing the victims and survivors of catastrophic injury and wrongful death in Oklahoma. Jacob's passion is to develop clients from whom he gains their trust, respect and admiration.

Jacob was born in Peoria, Illinois. He graduated in the top 5 of his class from Fairview High School in rural Northwest Oklahoma in 1994. He and his brothers, Josh (twin), Matt and Adam were All-State Basketball players at Fairview during their time at the school and led their teams to multiple state tournaments and individual awards.

Jacob went on from Fairview to Oklahoma State University where he was a pre-law major and went on to graduate with a BA in Political Science and a Minor in Business, with honors in May 1999. In August of 2000, Jacob was accepted and agreed to attend the University of Oklahoma College of Law in Norman, Oklahoma, where he regularly made the Dean's Honor Roll and also made a name for himself as a very outspoken and likable classmate. Jacob received his juris-doctorate degree from OU Law School in May 2002 and passed the Oklahoma Bar Exam in July 2002 to become an Oklahoma lawyer in September 2002.

Jacob then went to work for a small insurance defense firm in Oklahoma City for just over two (2) years before joining Glendell Nix & Noble McIntyre of Nix & McIntyre, LLP, to begin representing personal injury and wrongful death victims in Oklahoma. In 2009, Jacob proudly joined Glendell Nix to form Nix Law Group, with offices in Edmond, Oklahoma. In 2015, Nix Law Group joined forces with Maples Law Firm to form the new super power of Nix & Diesselhorst, PLLC.

Jacob takes great pride in helping the victims and families of those who have suffered serious injuries and/or death due to another person or corporation's improper conduct obtain the justice and compensation they are entitled to. Specifically, Jacob focuses his practice on representing the victims of birth injury and birth trauma throughout the State of Oklahoma. This includes cases involving:

- Hypoxic Brain Damage

- Birth Trauma

- Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)

- Periventricular Leukomalacia (PVL)

- Cerebral Palsy (CP)

- Seizure Disorder

- Brachial Plexus Injuries/Erb's Palsy

- Brain and Spinal Cord Injury

- Permanent Neurological Injuries

As one of only a handful of attorneys in the country practicing in this very specialized area of medical malpractice law, Jacob has gained a reputation of knowledge, passion, respect and hard-work amongst his colleagues on both sides of the aisle and from Oklahoma judges. In representing the victims of birth injury, obstetrical negligence and labor and delivery injury, Jacob has obtained numerous multi-million-dollar settlements for children and their families across the State. Settlements that have made a huge difference in improving the quality of life for these children who suffer from the effects of hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), which include spastic quadriplegic cerebral palsy, seizure disorder, cortical blindness, cognitive limitations and other permanent disabilities. Jacob is also an active member of the Birth Trauma Litigation Section of the American Association for Justice (AAJ) - an exclusive group of attorneys across the country who focus their practice representing children who have suffered birth injury or neonatal injury.

In addition to birth injury litigation, Jacob also focuses his legal practice on the following other complex areas of tort law:

1. Medical Malpractice and Medical Error/Neglect;

2. Trucking and Motor Vehicle Accidents involving catastrophic injuries and/or death; and

3. Brain and Spinal Cord Injury and other Neurological Injury Cases.

Jacob is also actively involved with the Oklahoma Association for Justice's (OAJ) legislative and political activities and is an active member of the OAJ's Advisory Board, Legislative Committee and Executive Board.

Jacob is married to Tressa Diesselhorst, his college sweetheart from OSU. They have 3 children, who are the pride and joy of Jacob's life, Gabriel Jacob, Hannah Beth and Lauren Lee. Jacob's children attend Deer Creek Public Schools in Edmond, Oklahoma.

Jacob is also a rabid sports fan and a proud season ticket holder for the Oklahoma City Thunder, Oklahoma City Energy and Oklahoma State Cowboys Football and Basketball. When he is not working long hours at the office on behalf of his clients, chances are you could find Jacob watching his kids play soccer, tennis or basketball or, quite possibly, trying to sneak in 18 holes of golf at his home course - Gaillardia Country Club in Oklahoma City.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Jacob is one of the most respected, aggressive and well-thought of trial attorneys in Oklahoma litigation today. Opposing counsel, judges and colleagues alike recognize Jacob's passionate and aggressive prosecution of cases on behalf of his clients. Jacob takes great pride in representing the victims and survivors of catastrophic injury and wrongful death in Oklahoma. Jacob's passion is to develop clients from whom he gains their trust, respect and admiration.

Jacob was born in Peoria, Illinois. He graduated in the top 5 of his class from Fairview High School in rural Northwest Oklahoma in 1994. He and his brothers, Josh (twin), Matt and Adam were All-State Basketball players at Fairview during their time at the school and led their teams to multiple state tournaments and individual awards.

Jacob went on from Fairview to Oklahoma State University where he was a pre-law major and went on to graduate with a BA in Political Science and a Minor in Business, with honors in May 1999. In August of 2000, Jacob was accepted and agreed to attend the University of Oklahoma College of Law in Norman, Oklahoma, where he regularly made the Dean's Honor Roll and also made a name for himself as a very outspoken and likable classmate. Jacob received his juris-doctorate degree from OU Law School in May 2002 and passed the Oklahoma Bar Exam in July 2002 to become an Oklahoma lawyer in September 2002.

Jacob then went to work for a small insurance defense firm in Oklahoma City for just over two (2) years before joining Glendell Nix & Noble McIntyre of Nix & McIntyre, LLP, to begin representing personal injury and wrongful death victims in Oklahoma. In 2009, Jacob proudly joined Glendell Nix to form Nix Law Group, with offices in Edmond, Oklahoma. In 2015, Nix Law Group joined forces with Maples Law Firm to form the new super power of Nix & Diesselhorst, PLLC.

Jacob takes great pride in helping the victims and families of those who have suffered serious injuries and/or death due to another person or corporation's improper conduct obtain the justice and compensation they are entitled to. Specifically, Jacob focuses his practice on representing the victims of birth injury and birth trauma throughout the State of Oklahoma. This includes cases involving:

- Hypoxic Brain Damage

- Birth Trauma

- Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)

- Periventricular Leukomalacia (PVL)

- Cerebral Palsy (CP)

- Seizure Disorder

- Brachial Plexus Injuries/Erb's Palsy

- Brain and Spinal Cord Injury

- Permanent Neurological Injuries

As one of only a handful of attorneys in the country practicing in this very specialized area of medical malpractice law, Jacob has gained a reputation of knowledge, passion, respect and hard-work amongst his colleagues on both sides of the aisle and from Oklahoma judges. In representing the victims of birth injury, obstetrical negligence and labor and delivery injury, Jacob has obtained numerous multi-million-dollar settlements for children and their families across the State. Settlements that have made a huge difference in improving the quality of life for these children who suffer from the effects of hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), which include spastic quadriplegic cerebral palsy, seizure disorder, cortical blindness, cognitive limitations and other permanent disabilities. Jacob is also an active member of the Birth Trauma Litigation Section of the American Association for Justice (AAJ) - an exclusive group of attorneys across the country who focus their practice representing children who have suffered birth injury or neonatal injury.

In addition to birth injury litigation, Jacob also focuses his legal practice on the following other complex areas of tort law:

1. Medical Malpractice and Medical Error/Neglect;

2. Trucking and Motor Vehicle Accidents involving catastrophic injuries and/or death; and

3. Brain and Spinal Cord Injury and other Neurological Injury Cases.

Jacob is also actively involved with the Oklahoma Association for Justice's (OAJ) legislative and political activities and is an active member of the OAJ's Advisory Board, Legislative Committee and Executive Board.

Jacob is married to Tressa Diesselhorst, his college sweetheart from OSU. They have 3 children, who are the pride and joy of Jacob's life, Gabriel Jacob, Hannah Beth and Lauren Lee. Jacob's children attend Deer Creek Public Schools in Edmond, Oklahoma.

Jacob is also a rabid sports fan and a proud season ticket holder for the Oklahoma City Thunder, Oklahoma City Energy and Oklahoma State Cowboys Football and Basketball. When he is not working long hours at the office on behalf of his clients, chances are you could find Jacob watching his kids play soccer, tennis or basketball or, quite possibly, trying to sneak in 18 holes of golf at his home course - Gaillardia Country Club in Oklahoma City.

attorneys.name: Amanda C. Dockrey
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Shawnee, OK
attorneys.bio:
Amanda C. Dockrey was born in Norman, Oklahoma, but primarily raised in southern Idaho. Mrs. Dockrey returned to her "Okie" roots, attending to her undergraduate studies at the University of Central Oklahoma where she graduated with a Bachelor of Arts Degree in Political Science in 2008. Thereafter, receiving legal education at Oklahoma City University School of Law and being admitted to the practice of law before all Oklahoma state courts in April 2013. Mrs. Dockrey has also been admitted to several tribal courts in Oklahoma.

Mrs. Dockrey has practiced family law and related areas of law in Oklahoma since 2013, including matters of Divorce, Custody, Child Support, Adoption, Guardianship, Estate Planning, and Business Planning. Additionally, she has experience as a county prosecutor for Pottawatomie County, Oklahoma.

Mrs. Dockrey is known for being a strong advocate in the Courtroom as well as giving sound legal advice and direction during settlement negotiations. Mrs. Dockrey listens to her client's needs and desires and understands the strain that a client undergoes during the court process.

Mrs. Dockrey resides in Shawnee, Oklahoma with her husband, Shane Dockrey, and three children. Her family enjoys hunting, competing at rodeos, attending church and working on the family ranch.

attorneys.name: Roger L. Ediger
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Enid, OK
attorneys.bio:
Roger L. Ediger was born in Enid, Oklahoma on November 17, 1954. He attended Tabor College in Hillsboro, Kansas receiving a Bachelor of Arts Degree in Business Administration and Economics in 1977. Roger subsequently received a Juris Doctorate Degree from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2002.

After graduating from college in 1973, Roger worked in the agricultural industry being involved in the family farming operation. He continues to maintain a farming interest in Garfield County. Roger has also been involved in shaping public policy in agriculture, having been invited to testify before Congress on several occasions and being the recipient of several fellowships to study economic policy relating to agriculture. He has also been in leadership positions in several farm organizations.

Roger was admitted to the Bar in Oklahoma in 2002. He is admitted to practice before all state courts and the United States District Court for the Western, Eastern, and Northern Districts. He is a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association, the American Bar Association, and the Christian Legal Society. Roger has a varied law practice including class actions, qui tam cases and bankruptcy work, primarily involving Chapter 7 and Chapter 13. Roger has been active in numerous church and community functions and organizations. He has also traveled extensively to Eastern Europe and Russia on numerous occasions for humanitarian and religious purposes. Roger is married to Catherine and they have two grown children, Ryan and Laura, and four grandchildren.

attorneys.name: Brant Elmore
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Brant M. Elmore has been practicing law in Oklahoma for more than 25 years. During that time, he has served as a litigator, appellate counsel, and a judicial officer.

Brant began his career in South Oklahoma City in a general practice where he primarily defended people charged with crimes. He worked cases throughout the state and successfully tried cases in both federal and state courts. Brant also worked for the Oklahoma Indigent Defense System working appeals where he helped free a man from death row.

Brant litigated cases as a prosecutor. He was the Managing Assistant District Attorney in Garvin County. Brant served as a prosecutor in the “Ballcap Bandit” cases. He worked death penalty cases as Assistant Attorney General. Promoted to Senior Assistant Attorney General, Brant prosecuted cases before the State’s Multicounty Grand Jury. Serving as Assistant District Attorney in Oklahoma County, he ensured that all defendants, past or present, received a fair and just trial. In 2023, Brant participated in the vacation of Glynn Simmons conviction for murder.

Brant was a staff attorney for Judge Gary L. Lumpkin on the Court of Criminal Appeals. He served as a Referee for the Oklahoma Supreme Court holding hearings on both legal and political issues. Brant was an Administrative Law Judge with the Oklahoma Tax Commission.

Coming full circle, Brant returned to criminal defense at Cannon & Associates. He seeks to leverage his experience to be a fierce advocate for his clients.

attorneys.practice_type: Receiverships (Abstract Companies) Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Kraettli Q. Epperson (AV rating), PLLC, is a partner with Mee, Mee, Hoge, & Epperson, P.L.L.P., conducting his law practice in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where he focuses on Real Property Litigation, Real Property Acquisitions and Development, Homeowners/Condominium Association Representation and Mineral Title Curative matters. Mr. Epperson serves as a Consulting Expert and Expert Witness on real estate title matters. He has practiced law since 1979.

Mr. Epperson has been, and continues to be, Chairman of the Title Examination Standards Committee of the Real Property Law Section of the Oklahoma Bar Association since 1992. He also has served, and continues to serve, as an Adjunct Professor of Law teaching "Oklahoma Land Titles" at the Oklahoma City University School of Law since 1982, and is a frequent writer and lecturer on real property law. He has also taught the Real Property portion of the Oklahoma Bar Review. Mr. Epperson has been a contributor to the annual update for Basye: Clearing Land Titles, and is the General Editor of and a contributing author to Vernons 2d: Oklahoma Real Property Forms and Practice. He conducts an annual survey of all 50 States to determine the status of their Title Examination Standards. In addition, he surveys all 77 County Clerks in Oklahoma annually to determine how to access their land records on-line. You can learn more about them at his website (www.Eppersonlaw.com).

attorneys.name: Sarah Faust
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Sarah Faust, originally from Dover Delaware, planted roots in Oklahoma seven years ago and never looked back. She started her time in Oklahoma by attending the University of Central Oklahoma where she earned degrees in Forensic Science and Psychology. It was at UCO in her forensic science classes where her journey as a lawyer began as she was captivated by the legal aspect of the criminal justice system she interacted with in class.

From there she attended Oklahoma City University School of Law. During law school Sarah was involved in the Criminal Law Association, the Innocence Project, and she obtained her Early Settlement Mediation Certification. It was when Sarah interned for the Public Defender’s Office at the Juvenile Justice Center when Sarah found a passion for helping kids through difficult situations. This passion is what led her to family law. It’s Sarah’s mission to Fiercely Advocate for her clients needs, wants, and walk with them during this difficult time in their life, and bring them comfort by knowing they are not going through this alone.

When Sarah is not at work, you can find her playing volleyball, cheering on the Oklahoma City Thunder, or hanging out with her cats Lira and Koda!

attorneys.name: Graham Fishburn
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio: Graham Fishburn grew up in Purcell Oklahoma and is a 4th generation Oklahoman. After graduating from Oklahoma State University, he was commissioned an officer in the U.S. Army and began serving on active duty. In 18 years, he deployed on multiple combat tours, served all over the world and is a Bronze Star recipient. After retirement from active duty, Graham came back to his hometown and attended law school to start a second career. Since then, he has worked for 3 different District Attorney's Offices, including McClain County in Purcell, Comanche County in Lawton, and Cleveland County in Norman. As an Assistant District Attorney, he managed both misdemeanor and felony criminal cases from start to finish, negotiating plea agreements and taking several to trial. As a defense attorney he works criminal cases in multiple counties in central, south central, and southwest Oklahoma.

attorneys.practice_type: Family law Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Matthew is an attorney at Ball Morse Lowe PLLC whose practice is focused on family law. Born and raised in Arizona, Matt is dedicated to serving Oklahomans in their domestic matters. He takes particular interest in family law, understanding the intricacies of the process and prioritizing the well-being of children and their parents throughout proceedings.

As the president of the Federalist Society, Matthew expressed a deep passion for law, particularly in safeguarding the constitutional rights of US citizens. Under his leadership, panels were organized to delve into significant topics in today's society, ensuring a balanced exploration of various perspectives. Collaborating with other organizations to facilitate these panels, he honed invaluable leadership skills that are now instrumental in his legal practice. Additionally, volunteering at the Oklahoma Legal Aid clinic provided him with hands-on experience, aiding individuals in locating appropriate legal forms for their cases. This experience sharpened Matthew's ability to pinpoint clients' needs and identify central issues in their concerns.

attorneys.name: Tom Hamilton
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Tom is beginning a second career after spending over 24 years in the United States Air Force. He served for 9 years in the Aircraft Armament Systems career field before joining the Judge Advocate General’s Corp as a paralegal in 2005. Immediately after his military retirement, he and his family moved to Oklahoma to pursue his dream of becoming a lawyer and continuing his service to the community.

During Tom’s 15 years in the Air Force JAG Corp, he was a trial team member of over 30 courts-martial cases ranging from drug offenses, rape and sexual assaults, and child abuse. In addition, while stationed in Texas he oversaw the U.S. Federal Magistrate Court program, prosecuting civilian misconduct occurring on military bases in Federal District Court. While deployed to Afghanistan, Tom provided support to multiple investigations for contract fraud and use of force/escalation of force incidents. After his promotion to the Senior Noncommission Officer ranks, Tom both inspected Air Force legal offices world-wide for compliance with the Uniformed Code of Military Justice and provided military specific legal training to senior enlisted leaders of all Air Force career fields.

When not working or spending time with his family, he enjoys golfing and playing softball. Tom also regularly volunteers to coach/judge negotiation competition teams at the OU College of Law.

attorneys.name: T. David Hasbrook
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
David attended the University of Oklahoma and obtained his undergraduate degree in Psychology in 1975 and his law degree in 1978. He then served over four years on active duty with the United States Army as a lawyer in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps. During this period, he gained valuable trial experience. After leaving active duty in 1982, David continued his military career in the United States Army Reserves until 2006, when he retired at the rank of Colonel.

Most of David’s practice involves representing people who are injured as a result of negligence. His cases are in both state and federal courts. He is admitted to practice before: all state courts in Oklahoma; the United States District Courts for the Northern, Eastern, and Western Districts of Oklahoma; the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals; and, the United States Supreme Court. At times, he has been a member of the American Trial Lawyers Association, the Oklahoma Trial Lawyers Association, the American Bar Association, the Oklahoma County Bar Association, and the Oklahoma Association for Justice.

Although David’s practice is primarily in the injury law arena, his experience involves all aspects of civil litigation. In his initial practice of law in Oklahoma City, his emphasis was in business litigation, both for Plaintiffs and Defendants. He later found more satisfaction and enjoyment in helping injured individuals recover for their losses or damages. So, for the last twenty years, he has concentrated his practice in the areas of personal injury and insurance law.

attorneys.name: Scott Blake Hawkins
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
With 18 years of civil litigation experience, Scott Blake Hawkins is a dedicated advocate for individuals facing challenges such as insurance disputes, catastrophic injuries, and unfair treatment. His areas of practice encompass health insurance, automobile insurance, homeowners' insurance, life insurance claims, trucking/commercial truck crashes, automobile crashes, workplace injuries, products liability, medical malpractice, brain injuries, and general litigation.

Scott graduated from the University of Oklahoma with both a Bachelor of Science and a Master of Science before earning his Juris Doctor from Oklahoma City University School of Law. During law school, he received the prestigious CALI Excellence for the Future Award® in Legal Research and Writing I & II and Client Representation in Negotiations. He is also a graduate of the renowned Trial Lawyers College in Dubois, Wyoming.

In a career marked by significant achievements, Scott was part of the legal team that secured a $62.7 million settlement, in conjunction with motivating corporate fatigue driving policy changes, in a landmark case involving a deadly turnpike collision, demonstrating his dedication to achieving justice for his clients.

In addition to his legal practice, Scott is deeply involved in the legal community. He serves on the Oklahoma Bar Association's Ethics and Evidence and Civil Procedure Committees and judges the association’s High School Mock Trial Competitions. He has also served as adjunct faculty, teaching trial practices to aspiring attorneys.

Scott is admitted to practice in all Oklahoma State and Federal Courts, the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals, and the United States Supreme Court. Over the course of his career, he has successfully tried numerous jury and bench trials to verdict.

A member of the Choctaw Nation and a native of a small southern Oklahoma town, Scott brings the values of hard work and community care to his practice. His approach to client care is grounded in strategic problem-solving, a strong presence, and an empathetic focus on reducing the uncertainty and frustration his clients face in and out of the courtroom.

Scott is devoted to being present for his clients in their time of need and guiding them through the complexities of their injury or insurance-related disputes.

attorneys.name: Blake A. Hayes
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Jenks, OK
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Hayes represents individuals, families and businesses in all aspects of the law including general civil and criminal litigation, personal injury, family law and business transactions.

Mr. Hayes has extensive experience representing plaintiffs in medical malpractice cases, auto accidents, slip and falls, and other personal injury claims. He has also defended property and casualty insurance carriers against injury and professional negligence claims. He represents individuals and businesses in litigation related to breach of contract, real estate transactions, and landlord/tenant disputes.

Mr. Hayes is skilled in family law matters including divorce, alimony, child custody and support, and paternity suits. He also routinely represents people charged with criminal offenses at the misdemeanor and felony level including DUI/DWI, drugs, domestic violence, and theft cases. In addition, Mr. Hayes performs title examination and curative work for oil and gas companies and land owners.

Mr. Hayes grew up in Arlington, Texas and received his Bachelor of Arts from the University of Oklahoma in 2002 and his Juris Doctorate from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2005.

attorneys.name: Alisha Hounslow
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Alisha Hounslow grew up in rural southwest Oklahoma and has always had a desire to help people. She received her undergraduate degree from the University of Oklahoma with a Bachelors of Science degree in Zoology-Biomedical Sciences. While earning her degree, she worked for both OU and the Cleveland County District Attorney’s child support division. After graduation, she began working full-time for the DA’s Office in their criminal records division as a Legal Assistant. Alisha worked for five years for multiple assistant district attorneys and her job duties included filing charges, motions, and extraditions.

In 2012, Alisha left the DA’s Office to work for the Law Office of Matt Swain. She managed the office and was also an assistant to a family law attorney, where she filed adoptions, divorces, and other family law case work. Alisha left the law office when she had the opportunity to work for the Oklahoma State Department of Health in 2014 where began her public health career as a Public Health Specialist in Cleveland County. As a PHS, she was responsible for a multitude of duties including conducting thousands of health inspections, working with restaurants and epidemiologists during foodborne illness outbreaks, facilitating rabies investigations, including testifying in District Court as an expert witness, and teaching hundreds of food safety courses.

However, ten years after obtaining her undergrad degree, Alisha decided to return to her first love of law. During her time at the University of Oklahoma College of Law, Alisha participated three semesters in the OU Legal Clinic, practicing both criminal and civil law under the supervision of professors. She was named the co-recipient of the Cindy Foley Award for outstanding legal clinic student. She also found time to intern at the Cleveland County DA’s Office and with the Swain Law Group, who subsequently hired her upon graduation.

Alisha is the utility player of the office, practicing all areas of law across the state, including criminal, family, and civil law. She also has experience with guardianships, expungements, and probate cases. She recognizes that needing legal representation can occur at a fragile time in people’s lives and works hard to assist them with navigating the complex legal system while also trying to ensure the best possible outcome for her clients.

Alisha currently lives in Norman with her family, loves sports, and her cats. She enjoys attending OU athletic events and participating in her children’s extracurricular and school activities. She also loves to work with various community partners and supports local charities and events.

attorneys.name: Jordan Hutchison
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Jordan Hutchison is zealous advocate for her clients and is always willing and able to go the extra mile for them. Her practice focuses primarily on family law matters including divorce, legal separation, guardianships, paternity, custody, adoption, child support issues and juvenile deprived matters. Jordan's practice also includes civil litigation and estate management including wills, trusts and probate. Jordan also has experience with representing adult and juveniles with mental health issues and navigating the court system if her client finds themselves in an involuntary commitment to an inpatient facility.

A graduate of Oklahoma University College of Law, Jordan is a member of the Family Law Section and the Juvenile Law Section of the Oklahoma Bar Association. Jordan obtained a certificate from Oklahoma University College of Law in Interdisciplinary Training Program in Child Abuse and Neglect. Jordan received a Bachelors of Arts in Criminal Justice as well as a Master of Arts in Political Science from the University of Central Oklahoma, where she graduated Magna Cum Laude.

Jordan has interned at the Oklahoma Supreme Court, Oklahoma Lawyers for Children, Legal Aid Palomar and Catholic Charities Legal and Immigration Services. Upon graduating from Oklahoma University College of Law, Jordan immediately began working at Swain Law Group where she continues to work today.

In Jordan's spare time she enjoys attending Oklahoma City Thunder games with her family and friends and living out her glory days playing soccer in an adult co-ed league.

attorneys.name: Sidney Jones Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
When a divorce or family law matter arises in Oklahoma City, it is common to feel overwhelmed and confused. These cases often have long-lasting effects on your life, and ensuring that you have caring and dedicated legal representation to protect your rights can make all the difference in the end. Sidney Jones is a compassionate Associate Attorney at Stange Law Firm. Based in our Oklahoma County office, she can help individuals throughout the Oklahoma City area and nearby.

Sidney attended law school at the University of Oklahoma College of Law, where she earned her Juris Doctor in May 2023. Before law school, she attended Gonzaga University, where she obtained her Bachelor of Arts in Journalism while also earning her Minor in Solidarity & Social Justice. Sidney is licensed to practice law in the state of Oklahoma.

Sidney is a forward-thinking attorney with a diverse legal background. Before joining the Oklahoma City divorce and family lawyers at Stange Law Firm, Sidney most recently worked as an Associate Attorney, where she drafted and filed motions and briefs in both state and federal courts. She developed case strategies tailored to clients’ needs and represented clients in Oklahoma state court hearings. She also conducted legal research and prepared legal memorandums on novel legal issues, contributing to case strategies for multiple managing attorneys handling a high volume of cases. Previously, she interned at the Oklahoma Medical Marijuana Authority, where she corresponded with attorneys and license holders on legal questions, tracked ongoing issues in Excel, and conducted legal research relevant to the agency. Before that, she interned at a legal aid organization, assisting with eviction prevention efforts, conducting intake calls, and drafting legal documents. She also had an internship focused on trusts and estates law, where she organized documents for a pro bono bankruptcy case.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.bio:
Patrick H. Kernan is Of Counsel with the Helton Law Firm. He has been in the active practice of law in Oklahoma since 1975. He graduated from Oklahoma State University with a degree in Business Administration and earned his Juris Doctor from Oklahoma City University, graduating in the top 10% of his law school class. He is permitted to practice before all state and federal courts in Oklahoma, the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals and the United States Supreme Court.

Mr. Kernan has focused his law practice on civil litigation, business contract law, estate planning, and probate law. He has tried more than 80 cases to verdict in state and federal courts dealing with trust & estate disputes, commercial transactions, business torts, bad faith insurance claims, oil & gas, securities fraud, fiduciary claims, and personal injury litigation. In addition, Mr. Kernan has represented the Oklahoma Board of Bar Examiners for over forty (40) years and in such capacity has tried over 150 administrative cases before the Board of Bar Examiners related to character & fitness of individuals who have made applications to practice law in Oklahoma.

attorneys.name: Lindsay Kistler
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law (Employer) Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Born and raised in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, Lindsay N. Kistler attended the University of Oklahoma and graduated in 2012 with a bachelor’s degree in political science with a minor in philosophy. After working for a year at a small law firm, Lindsay attended the University of Oklahoma College of Law, graduating in 2016 with honors. During her time in law school, Lindsay served as the Editor-in-Chief of the Oklahoma Law Review in addition to competing on two moot court teams. Lindsay was awarded the Outstanding Third Year Law Student Award by the Oklahoma Bar Association, and upon graduation, she was inducted into the Order of the Coif for graduating in the top 10% of the class, the Order of the Barristers for being one of the top 10 oral advocates for the class, and the Order of the Scribes for being one of the top writers of the class.

Upon graduation, Lindsay joined a large firm in downtown Oklahoma City where she represented primarily companies in both commercial and employment disputes and lawsuits filed in state and federal court. After over five years at the large firm, Lindsay started her own solo practice in 2022 where she continues to serve her clients with a variety of matters, including pre-litigation disputes, state and federal cases, arbitrations, and contract negotiations. Most recently, and for the third year in a row, Lindsay was selected by her peers for inclusion in the 2024 edition of Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch for her expertise in Labor and Employment Law—Management. In her free time, Lindsay enjoys cycling, gardening, traveling, and spending time with her friends and family.
