attorneys.name: John Kristjansson Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Facing a family law matter in Tulsa, Oklahoma is never easy. Working towards a brighter future can be easier when working with legal representation that understands the situation you face. John Kristjansson is a Senior Associate Attorney with Stange Law Firm. He can help represent clients throughout Tulsa County, OK, and the surrounding areas from the firm’s Tulsa, Oklahoma family law office.

John attended the University of Tulsa College of Law where he obtained his Juris Doctor in December 2017. Prior to earning his law degree, he earned his Bachelor of Science degree from Oklahoma State University in December 2014, majoring in Liberal Studies and minoring in Political Science, History, and American Studies. John is licensed to practice law in Oklahoma and is a member of the Tulsa County Bar Association, American Bar Association, Cherokee Nation Bar Association, and is also admitted to practice law in the Federal District Court for the Northern District of Oklahoma.

Before joining the family law and divorce lawyers at Stange Law Firm in Tulsa, John most recently served as a Contract Attorney for the City of Tulsa Municipal Public Defender, where he represented indigent defendants and developed the office’s McGirt Motion template, including the selection of attachments. Since May 2018, he has also maintained a solo practice in Tulsa, successfully securing the dismissal of a juvenile case on UCCJEA subject-matter grounds and representing an appellee in the Oklahoma Court of Civil Appeals. In 2017, he externed with the Federal Public Defender’s Office in Tulsa, drafting motions, conducting appellate research, and preparing memoranda. As part of the Lobeck-Taylor Community Advocacy Clinic, he co-authored a policy review on criminal court cost reforms and gained hands-on experience in client advocacy and policy work.

Before practicing law, John served in the United States Army from 1998 to 2012, where he managed administrative tasks for personnel, resolved pay and record issues, and supported Brigade-level operations with mapping and battle-tracking.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.name: Tim D. Kuykendall
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Since leaving the District Attorney's Office in 2007, Tim has established a very successful private law practice as an attorney in The Kuykendall Law Office, Norman, Oklahoma. He limits his practice to mainly criminal cases in both State and Municipal Courts, handling both felony and misdemeanor cases. His office can also help you with any personal injury cases.

Tim was the elected district attorney for three terms for Cleveland, McClain and Garvin counties. During his tenure he has supervised a staff of approximately 100 employees, including attorneys, investigators, interns and secretaries; managed an annual budget of 5.6 million dollars; and prosecuted and / or supervised the prosecution of felony cases, including eight death penalty cases and 130 homicide cases.

Tim initiated numerous programs while at the District Attorneys office, including the Domestic Violence Unit, Adult Drug Court Program, Juvenile Drug Court Program, Community Sentencing, Mental Health Court, Multijurisdictional Drug Task Force, and a Truancy Program. He supervised a very successful child support division, increasing collection to over 12 million annually. The program won Oklahoma’s Office of the Year award in 1999, 2000, 2001 and 2004, as well as the 2005 National Child Support Enforcement Association’s Most Outstanding Program award.

While serving as a project director, Tim solicited and received numerous grants, including a $500,000 drug court grant from the justice department. Other grants include a JAIBG grant (juvenile prosecution grant); VOCA grant (Victim of Crimes Act); VAWA grant (Violence Against Women Act); and a BYRNE grant (Multijurisdictional Drug Task Force Grant).

Tim has extensive experience dealing with public media. He has appeared on “60 Minutes,” “Good Morning America,” Forensic Files, “America’s Most Wanted” and CNN. He has organized and participated in fundraising events for March of Dimes, American Cancer Society, Special Olympics, Juvenile Diabetes Association, Ally’s House, Thunderbird Clubhouse, Meals on Wheels, J.D. McCarty Center, Mary Abbott House, United Cerebral Palsy, Salvation Army, Angel Tree Program and the United Way. In addition, Tim has been the red ribbon event speaker for Norman and Moore public schools. He has also been a guest lecturer for sociology and political science classes at the University of Oklahoma, as well as a guest speaker at civic clubs, fraternities and sororities, senior citizen centers, the Council on Law Enforcement Education Training, and others.

Tim served as the chairman of the Law Enforcement Block Grant Program and a board member of the Oklahoma District Attorney’s Association.

As assistant District Attorney, Tim prosecuted felony cases, including homicide and death penalty cases. He served as a chief drug prosecutor and a multijurisdictional drug task force project director. He lectured for various law enforcement classes and handled numerous asset forfeiture cases. Tim was also responsible for supervising and training legal interns.

Honors

National College of District Attorneys' Career Prosecutor Course Graduate, 1985

Assistant District Attorney of the Year, Oklahoma's District Attorney Association, 1992

Law Enforcement Humane Ethics Award from Second Chance, 1997 - 1998

District Attorney of the Year, Oklahoma’s District Attorney Association, 1998

Sons of the American Revolution Law Enforcement Commendation Medal, 1999

Interfraternity Council Outstanding Chapter Advisor, 2002, 2005, 2006

attorneys.name: Larry D. Lahman
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Enid, OK
attorneys.bio:
Larry Lahman is the Senior Partner in the oldest law firm in Oklahoma - Mitchell DeClerck formed in the Oklahoma Territory in 1893 - joining the firm in 1975.

Larry Lahman has an active and varied practice, handling complex multi-million dollar class actions, mass actions involving hundreds if not thousands of clients, multi-million dollar qui tam cases under state and federal false claims acts, mass tort cases, and complex bankruptcy cases. And even assisting blockbuster motion pictures.

Lahman's practice uniquely incorporates his knowledge of computer programming, big data and data analysis beginning 50 years ago with his first programming course in graduate school.

Lahman is admitted to practice before the United States Supreme Court, the Oklahoma Supreme Court, all Oklahoma trial courts and 12 of the 13 United States Courts of Appeal. He has litigated cases in federal courts in Alabama, Distict of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas and Washington.

Lahman has a BS degree in chemistry with a minor in mathematics and physics from Northwestern Oklahoma State University, a JD in law from the University of Oklahoma College of Law and attended graduate school at Oklahoma State University as well as the University of Delaware, the University of Maryland, North Carolina State University, Central Oklahoma State University and Phillips University. He has over 300 academic hours at eight colleges and universities. He is inventor of United States Patent 6,550,491 issued by the US Patent and Trademark Office.

Lahman served as President of Garfield County Bar Association, President of Enid Noon Lions Club, two terms as Chairman of Enid Salvation Army Advisory Board and two terms as Chairman of Garfield County Republican Central Committee. He also served as Vice Chairman of County Red Cross Chapter and as a Presidential Elector for President Reagan as a member of the Electoral College in 1984. He served as a member of or delegate to numerous bar, civic and Republican State and local committees and task forces and is currently a recovering Republican.

Lahman served nearly four years on active duty as a paratrooper and volunteered for four tours of service in Vietnam with the U.S. Army Special Forces commonly known as the Green Berets. While in Vietnam and contiguous countries in Southeast Asia, he commanded an 800-man force involved in actual combat in enemy controlled areas on the Cambodian Border and elsewhere. He has two Bronze Stars, an Air Medal, two Army Commendation Medals and other awards and decorations including the Combat Infantryman's Badge for actions in Vietnam. He was promoted from Private during 28 years of service to the rank of Lieutenant Colonel nearly all of which were with the U.S. Army Special Forces both active and reserve and is now retired.

Lahman served as President of Garfield County Bar Association, President of Enid Noon Lions Club, two terms as Chairman of Enid Salvation Army Advisory Board and two terms as Chairman of Garfield County Republican Central Committee. He also served as Vice Chairman of County Red Cross Chapter and as a Presidential Elector for President Reagan as a member of the Electoral College in 1984. He served as a member of or delegate to numerous bar, civic and Republican State and local committees and task forces and is currently a recovering Republican.

Lahman served nearly four years on active duty as a paratrooper and volunteered for four tours of service in Vietnam with the U.S. Army Special Forces commonly known as the Green Berets. While in Vietnam and contiguous countries in Southeast Asia, he commanded an 800-man force involved in actual combat in enemy controlled areas on the Cambodian Border and elsewhere. He has two Bronze Stars, an Air Medal, two Army Commendation Medals and other awards and decorations including the Combat Infantryman's Badge for actions in Vietnam. He was promoted from Private during 28 years of service to the rank of Lieutenant Colonel nearly all of which were with the U.S. Army Special Forces both active and reserve and is now retired.

Jeff graduated from the University of Oklahoma in 1971 and received in Juris Doctorate from Oklahoma City University in 1976. He is a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association, Oklahoma County Bar Association, Oklahoma Trial Lawyers Association, and American Association for Justice.

He has taught other lawyers regarding the handling of automobile accident cases by speaking at Continuing Legal Education seminars at the request of the Oklahoma Bar Association.

By way of appeal to the Supreme Court of Oklahoma, Jeff has obtained favorable decisions which now published case law are further protecting the rights of people who are injured in accidents.

Jeff is also a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum in recognition of receiving a jury trial verdict in the amount of more than one million dollars.

Jeff and his wife, Debbie, live in Oklahoma City. He has two sons, Alan and Greg, and two grandsons.

attorneys.name: Alex Lane
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Alex grew up in Newcastle, Oklahoma. He received his undergraduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin. While earning his undergraduate degree at the University of Texas, Alex interned with the Travis County Drug Court Program assisting individuals modify their driver's licenses. Alex returned to Oklahoma for law school, where he attended the University of Oklahoma College of Law and met his wife, Tayler. During law school, Alex earned his legal intern's license and practiced in the OU Law Criminal Clinic. He attended the OU Law Oxford program and was a student member of the Luther Bohanon Inn of Court.

Alex interned for the Oklahoma Attorney General's Office and for the Cleveland County District Attorney's Office. After graduating law school, Alex was hired as an Assistant District Attorney for the Cleveland County District Attorney's Office, where he practiced for 5 years. During his time as an Assistant District Attorney, Alex prosecuted thousands of cases from beginning to end, including jury trials ranging from DUI to Murder.

Alex handled the Community Sentencing Prison Diversion Program for the Cleveland County District Attorney's office, where he grew the program's participation. During his time at the District Attorney's office, Alex regularly taught courses to the Oklahoma City Police Department, Norman Police Department, and Oklahoma Highway Patrol.

Alex helps people navigate the complicated and often frustrating process of dealing with insurance companies and medical providers. He uses the skills he learned and honed as a prosecutor to help victims injured by someone else to achieve justice. When insurance companies refuse to do the right thing, Alex fights for his clients and holds the insurance companies accountable.

In his spare time, Alex enjoys spending time with his wife and two dogs. He is an avid traveller and scuba diver. He also enjoys hunting and fishing on his family's cattle ranch. Alex volunteers as a therapy dog handler with his dog Bandit. Alex and Bandit belong to the Human Animal Link of Oklahoma (H.A.L.O.), where Alex serves as a board member.

attorneys.name: Patrick Lane
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Patrick Lane is a seasoned attorney with a unique practice specializing in both litigation and transactional law. His extensive experience across diverse industries provides clients with comprehensive legal strategies that address both immediate needs and long-term goals. Patrick prides himself on building strong, collaborative relationships with clients, offering practical, solutions-oriented advice that is tailored to each unique situation.

In the courtroom, Patrick is known for his experienced, thoughtful approach and professionalism. He has successfully represented clients in a wide range of cases, including numerous types of commercial litigation, contract disputes, contested probates, trust litigation, and nursing home negligence cases, consistently achieving favorable outcomes through both negotiation and litigation.

On the transactional side, Patrick assists clients in navigating complex legal landscapes from startups to the sale of a business and nearly everything in between. He is a specialist in matters such as entity formation, contract drafting and review, business purchases and sales, and commercial real estate transactions, ensuring that clients' interests are protected, and their business objectives are met.

Patrick received his Juris Doctor from Oklahoma City University School of Law in 2011. While attending law school, he was a merit scholar and member of the Phi Delta Phi Honors Legal Fraternity. During his law school career, Patrick was a judicial clerk for Dana Kuehn, who was recently appointed to the Oklahoma Supreme Court.

In addition to his Juris Doctor, Patrick also received his Master’s in Business Administration from Oklahoma City University Meinders School of Business in 2011, where he was nominated by the faculty to attend the 2010 World Business Forum in New York City. For his undergraduate studies, Patrick received his Bachelor of Arts in religious studies from the University of Oklahoma with a minor in history.

attorneys.name: Victoria Lewis
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Victoria Lewis, a native of New Mexico, brings a unique blend of rural upbringing and legal expertise to Cannon & Associates. Raised on her family’s cattle ranch, Victoria developed a strong work ethic and a deep sense of community.

She earned her bachelor’s from Texas Tech University in 2021 before moving to Oklahoma to attend Oklahoma City University School of Law. During law school, Victoria made the Dean’s Honor Roll and graduated with a certificate in Dispute Resolution in 2024. Her journey with Cannon & Associates began as a legal intern, where she discovered her passion for family law. This early experience, combined with her personal insight as a child of divorce, has shaped her approach to cases as an associate attorney.

Victoria is dedicated to understanding the unique circumstances of each client, offering compassion and diligence through their legal challenges. She is committed to providing thoughtful support and striving for the best outcomes during the most difficult time for families.

When she’s not fiercely advocating for her clients, Victoria enjoys diving into a good book on her Kindle, relaxing with her dog, Sophie, or cheering on Texas Tech sports (because she might be an Okie now, but she’s forever a Red Raider).

attorneys.name: Sandra Magar
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Sandra Magar is an experienced trial attorney practicing family and probate law as well as estate planning. She is dedicated to providing her clients with the best possible representation in and out of the courtroom.

As a skilled attorney with personal experience in divorce and blended families, she recognizes the impact divorce and custody issues can have on various family members. Focused on providing the best results for her clients, she continually strives to reach a final outcome that favors her clients and provides them with a positive resolution of their issues.

Estate planning provides Sandra’s clients with peace of mind, knowing the details of their individual legacy were thoughtfully designed and planned. Completing estate planning allows her clients to ensure their estate is protected and distributed as they intended, and it prevents the State of Oklahoma from determining how the estate will be distributed.

Prior to joining Cannon & Associates as a Fierce Advocate, she spent the initial years of her legal career as an assistant district attorney for Oklahoma County. In 2014, Sandra started her own successful law practice, through which she had the privilege of representing hundreds of clients. Today, as a senior attorney at Cannon & Associates, she continues to bring her enthusiasm, passion and legal experience to each case as her clients seek answers to their legal issues.

Sandra lives in Moore with her amazing husband, two crazy dogs and one sleepy cat. She enjoys traveling to visit her exceptional grandchildren and watching them grow up. In the warmer months, she enjoys jogging, but she always chooses to knit in the colder months instead of “working out”!

attorneys.name: Melissa P Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Energy and Natural Resouces Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Melissa Martin is a dedicated oil and gas attorney at Ball Morse Lowe, where she leverages her deep industry knowledge to guide clients through complex energy and estate matters. With a passion for helping people and a mission to leave the world better than she found it, Melissa provides strategic legal counsel in oil and gas law, estate planning, probate, and real property matters.

Her firsthand experience as the executor of her grandparents’ estate gave her a profound understanding of the challenges families face in estate administration. This personal insight, coupled with her legal expertise, drives her commitment to making the process as seamless as possible for her clients.

Melissa's legal career began with a clerkship for Federal District Judge A. Richard Caputo in the summer of 2006, providing her with invaluable insight into the judicial process. After law school, Melissa spent a number of years working for the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation, taking a deep dive into administrative law.

Melissa specializes in oil and gas law, estate planning, and probate, with a focus on oil and gas title opinions. She enjoys assisting royalty owners and division order departments in resolving title issues and releasing suspense. In a prior role managing the Division Order department for a local Fortune 500 energy company, Melissa worked on several projects across multiple assets in Oklahoma, Ohio, Texas, Wyoming, and Pennsylvania. She also has experience as a corporate attorney in the Land department, curing title for drilling and production

Melissa is an active member of several professional organizations, including the Oklahoma City Mineral Lawyers Society, the Estate Planning, Probate, and Trust Section and the Real Property Law Section of the Oklahoma Bar Association, the Oklahoma City Association of Professional Landmen, and the National Association of Division Order Analysts. She is also a proud graduate of the Oklahoma Bar Association Leadership Academy (Class 8).

attorneys.name: Katherine R. Mazaheri
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Katherine Mazaheri is a trial lawyer who regularly represents plaintiff employees in all areas of employment law, including litigation in state and federal courts, in mediation, before administrative agencies such as the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC), Department of Labor (DOL) and Oklahoma Employment Security Commission (OESC). She has successfully handled litigation involving claims of wrongful discharge, sexual harassment/assault, employment discrimination (based on race, age, gender, sexual stereotyping, pregnancy, national origin, and disability), retaliation, as well as disputes involving wage and hour matters, medical leave, confidentiality and non-compete agreements, employee handbook and company policy violations, and breaches of employment agreements.

With grit, resourcefulness, and resilience, Katherine brings an unparalleled ability to overcome any obstacle, both inside and outside of the courtroom. From securing substantial recoveries in discrimination lawsuits to beating breast cancer, she is no stranger to championing success in adverse environments. With first-hand knowledge of what it takes to defy the odds, compassion is the driving factor behind everything she does. Employing this perspective, she continually sets a new standard for client representation and litigation strategy. Highly regarded for her outstanding client advocacy and commitment to social justice, she has been granted numerous awards, including the Oklahoma Bar Association’s Ada Lois Sipuel Fisher Diversity Award (2022) and the Journal Record’s Leadership in Law Award (2021). She has also been featured in several well-known industry publications, including the Oklahoma Bar Journal and the Oklahoma County Bar Association Briefcase.

Above all, Katherine values fostering trustworthy, collaborative relationships with internal team members and external stakeholders. Recognized for being a synergistic business partner and employment law expert, she is regularly called upon to provide employment law training and continuing education to esteemed organizations. Recently, she led a successful, first-of-its-kind sexual harassment training for over 400 local tribal administrators. She was also included as a speaker at the Oklahoma Bar Association’s Labor and Employment Law Update and Oklahoma City University School of Law’s Alumni Association’s continuing education seminar.

As part of her employment practice, Katherine often trains and counsels employers on a broad range of matters affecting the workplace, including hiring, discipline, terminations, policies and procedures (including creation and auditing employment handbooks), drug and alcohol testing, anti-discrimination and anti-harassment, employment contracts, severance agreements, and confidentiality agreements. She has also had the opportunity to educate tribal employees on sexual harassment and train 400+ employees in the workplace. In addition, she was included as a speaker for continuing education for attorneys in 2019-2022 for Oklahoma Employment Lawyers Association, Oklahoma City University School of Law’s Alumni Association, Oklahoma Bar Association’s Labor and Employment Law, and for Oklahoma Bar Association’s Women in Law Conference.

attorneys.name: Kenneth T. McConkey
attorneys.practice_type: Business Entity Formation Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Mr. McConkey’s expertise centers on transactional law, with approximately 20% of his practice dedicated to litigation arising from those transactions. With a career devoted to serving both individual and business clients, he recognizes the inseparable nature of personal and commercial interests, offering sophisticated counsel that addresses both. His practice emphasizes structured planning for future challenges and adept resolution of current disputes, honed through years of guiding entrepreneurs, startups, and established enterprises.

Mr. McConkey excels in business entity selection and formation, drafting precise owner agreements to prevent conflicts, and advising on maintenance, evolution, or dissolution of business structures. He possesses extensive experience in drafting and negotiating critical agreements such as subscription and licensing agreements, referral and reseller agreements, and more, ensuring clients’ interests are safeguarded and objectives are met. He further brings deep knowledge of non-disclosure agreements, data processing agreements, and master services agreements, helping clients mitigate risks and protect assets amid a dynamic digital landscape.

Additionally, Mr. McConkey is a trusted advisor in data privacy and cybersecurity, developing robust policies and protocols to comply with ever-evolving laws and regulations. His approach is rooted in fostering enduring client relationships built on trust, clear communication, and a strategic alignment with business goals. Proactive and responsive, he empowers clients to navigate complex legal terrains, from commercial contracts to privacy challenges, delivering tailored, results-oriented solutions.

Prior to rejoining the Firm full-time, Mr. McConkey served as Deputy General and General Counsel for global Software-as-a-Service and Software companies. Prior to attending law school Mr. McConkey utilized his bachelor’s degree in management information systems as a Certified Information Systems Auditor for Verizon Communications, and an analyst for the Hertz Corporation.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Sue Lorenz Memorial Award for Outstanding Service to the National Energy Environmental Law and Policy Institute

attorneys.name: Gary M. McDonald
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Gary has developed a balanced practice over the past 50 years by providing counsel to individuals and business organizations while also undertaking litigation matters for clients in various forums and industries. This blend of experience has given Gary a unique perspective not common in today’s legal environment and culture.

In addition to development of the business advisor aspect of his practice, Gary has developed experience and expertise which mark him as a regional leader in business litigation and corporate restructuring matters in and out of court. Gary is equally comfortable in a corporate boardroom or a federal courtroom and seeks to develop practical and cost-effective solutions to the challenges which face businesses.

Gary is recognized by The Best Lawyers in America as among the nation’s best in business reorganization. He has represented debtors and Official Unsecured Creditor Committees which have successfully obtained confirmed Bankruptcy Plans of Reorganization in many industries, including tier one automotive manufacturing, grocery, wholesale food distribution, petroleum production, petroleum transportation, petroleum engineering, natural gas gathering systems, retail, financial services, commercial real estate, real estate development, steel mill and production, energy producers interests and medical technology. Gary has on a regular basis, represented the interest of investors, lenders, secured creditors, and Committees of Creditors.

Gary is active in community affairs and professional associations, serving or having served as a board member and officer of several civic and professional organizations, including service on the Tulsa Catholic Diocesan Finance Counsel and the Margaret Hudson Program. Gary is a frequent seminar lecturer in subjects involving Creditors’ Rights, and for the past several years has moderated and lectured in various programs focusing on bankruptcy litigation practice.

attorneys.bio:
Special Counsel for Estate Law

Anne M. McKinney is Special Counsel to Gale Allison, PLLC bringing her four decades of legal and tax experience in estate planning, probate and estate administration, and estate taxes. Ms. McKinney holds a Bachelor of Arts from Duke University, graduating magna cum laude and earned her Doctorate of Jurisprudence from the University of North Carolina School of Law. She is licensed to practice in Tennessee and North Carolina, all the courts in those states, and before the U.S. Tax Court, the 6th Circuit Court of Appeals and the U.S. Supreme Court. Ms. McKinney previously served as an Estate and Gift Tax Attorney with the Internal Revenue Service. As an Adjunct Professor of Law, she taught undergraduate Estate Planning, Wealth Transfer Tax, and Business Law at the University of Tennessee.

Ms. McKinney is a partner at McKinney & Tillman, P.C. in Knoxville, Tennessee. She is a member of the Tennessee and North Carolina Bar Associations and the American Bar Association and is a Fellow in the prestigious American College of Trust and Estate Counsels (ACTEC).

Ms. McKinney co-authored Estate Planning in Tennessee. She also lectures frequently before professional and civic groups throughout the nation on the subjects of estate planning and taxation.

attorneys.name: Tynia McQuigg
attorneys.practice_type: Intellectual Property Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Tynia A. McQuigg is a seasoned litigation and transactional intellectual property attorney with extensive experience in contract drafting and review, patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, litigation, and regulatory matters. With a proven ability to provide creative legal solutions and advice, Tynia has successfully assisted clients in various industries, including software, technology, food and beverage, education, retail, healthcare, banking, real estate, literary, art, and energy.

Professional Background

With extensive knowledge in intellectual property matters, Tynia has handled extensive trademark, copyright, and patent portfolios, including enforcement, clearance, analysis, due diligence, and prosecution for a wide variety of industries. She is skilled in drafting, analyzing, and prosecuting copyright, patent, and trademark applications. Additionally, Tynia has assisted clients in identifying, protecting, and analyzing their intellectual property and in the review and analysis of product and marketing information, ensuring that clients’ intellectual property rights are well-protected and effectively managed.

Tynia has a strong background in technology and contract matters, having drafted, reviewed, analyzed, and communicated regarding a variety of contracts, data privacy, cybersecurity, and business matters. She is skilled at negotiating and producing desired outcomes related to clients’ business and assists them in licensing and SaaS agreements, service contracts, publishing, purchase agreements, website terms and conditions, privacy policies, data security policies, and other vendor and corporate contracts. Her expertise in these areas has enabled her to provide valuable legal insights and solutions to clients across different sectors.

Tynia is experienced as lead trial attorney for various complex litigation matters in state and federal courts including copyright, patent, trademark, trade secret, oil and gas, and environmental cases. Her skills in conducting legal research, drafting memoranda, reports, and opinions, and managing eDiscovery and litigation schedules from initiation through trial have been instrumental in achieving successful outcomes for her clients.

attorneys.name: Justin Miller
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Justin Miller is a dedicated personal injury attorney whose path to the legal profession began in an unexpected place: a college marketing program. Everything changed when he took a business law class during his junior year. As a first-generation attorney, Justin immediately felt drawn to the power of advocacy and knew he had found his calling.

From the start of law school, Justin felt a strong pull toward personal injury work. While studying case law, he was inspired by the role that plaintiff’s attorneys play in protecting people facing life-altering injuries. That realization shaped his career and fuels his passion for standing up for those who need support the most.

Justin takes a client-first approach to every case. Having seen close friends injured in serious accidents, he understands the emotional and financial strain these events cause. He evaluates each case with diligence and precision, ensuring every detail is thoroughly reviewed. His confidence and strong communication skills make him a talented negotiator who fights to secure the compensation his clients deserve.

Originally from Acworth, Georgia, Justin moved to Edmond, Oklahoma, in 2015 and later built his career at a mid-sized personal injury firm before joining DM Injury Law. Outside of work, he enjoys golf, basketball, weightlifting, and cheering on his favorite sports teams.

attorneys.name: Haley Mock
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Haley is a proud Texas native who made her way north to Oklahoma City. Raised in Alvin, Texas, a suburb of Houston, she earned her degree in Health and Kinesiology from the University of Texas at Tyler. Following graduation, she began her career in public service as a Nutrition Education Associate with the East Texas Food Bank.

After a few years in the nonprofit world, Haley decided to explore the business side of things and took a job as executive assistant at CPA firm. That experience sparked something—she realized she loved working with people, organizing chaos into spreadsheets, and solving problems. She knew she wanted a career that combined all of that with her heart for helping others. This realization lead her to family law.

Haley earned her Juris Doctor from Oklahoma City University School of Law. While in law school, she was recognized with the CALI Award for Excellence, awarded the Dean’s Scholarship, and was actively involved in the Texas Legal Society and Family Law Society.

Today, Haley focuses exclusively on family law, where her compassionate approach and meticulous attention to detail allow her to advocate powerfully for her clients. She understands that most clients come to her during some of the most difficult times of their lives, and she is committed to providing support, clarity, and strong legal representation every step of the way.

Her areas of practice include divorce, paternity, child custody, visitation, alimony, child support, guardianship, and adoption.

Outside the office, Haley enjoys spending time with her Labrador retriever, attending group fitness classes, and cheering on the Oklahoma City Thunder.

Colleen has several years’ experience fighting for her clients in the courtroom and resolving cases in multiple states. Colleen is a native of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and graduated in 2011 Cum Laude from Duquesne University with her Bachelor of Arts in International Relations. She also graduated from Oral Roberts University in 2014 Summa Cum Laude with her Master of Arts and Master of Divinity. During her final year of graduate school, she was named Overall Outstanding Student and served as the graduate department Student Body President. Colleen then graduated from Loyola University Chicago School of Law with her Juris Doctorate. Colleen also has extensive experience in worker’s compensation and insurance defense and is currently admitted to practice law in Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Tennessee.

Colleen has been married for over ten years to her husband, Adam, and together they share two daughters. During her free time, Colleen enjoys traveling, baking, and spending time with her family and friends.

attorneys.name: Stephanie Moser
attorneys.practice_type: Oil and Gas Title Examination Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Stephanie Moser is a partner at Ball Morse Lowe PLLC and co-chair of the firm’s oil, gas + energy practice group.

In 2008 she earned her Juris Doctorate from the University of Oklahoma College of Law and a certificate in American Indian Law from the Center for the Study of American Indian Law and Policy. She has over fifteen years of experience in multiple tribal, state, and federal jurisdictions in which she is licensed to practice.

Stephanie has dedicated her career to developing a unique set of skills in oil and gas title examination and Native American real property. As a specialist in title issues involving restricted and trust lands, she is exceptionally qualified to help our firm’s clients navigate complex jurisdictional issues involving the development of natural resources in tribal reservations and allotments. She has served as the 2025 Chairperson of the Oklahoma Bar Association Real Property Section and is also a member of the Real Property Section’s Title Examination Standards Committee, which drafts the standards for marketable title to real property in the State of Oklahoma.

Stephanie regularly speaks at continuing legal education events and other professional development seminars to educate participants about recent developments in energy law and Native American law and policy. By sharing her expertise in how these two complex areas of law intersect, her goal is to empower industry professionals and tribal governments to work together to create new economic development opportunities in energy.

In her free time, Stephanie enjoys shooting sporting clays, creating kiln-formed glass art, and planning her next outdoor adventures.

attorneys.bio:
Jared Nelson is an Attorney with Helton Law Firm, advising clients on transactional, regulatory, and compliance matters involving corporate, business, intellectual property, technology, and health care issues.

He has represented clients ranging from small, single-employee businesses to large national corporations, in both private practice and in-house counsel roles. Jared is recognized for his technical command of the law, regularly designing innovative business arrangements and customized transaction structures to meet the unique needs of his clients.

He serves clients across a broad range of transactional and compliance matters, from general corporate and business operations to specialized work in health care and technology. Jared has extensive experience structuring agreements, navigating regulatory compliance, and counseling clients through complex business arrangements.

Outside of his legal practice, Jared enjoys spending time with his wife and three sons. A native of Texas, he came to Tulsa for law school and has embraced the region’s outdoor lifestyle, enjoying hiking, cycling, and other activities with his family.

Jared is a lymphoma survivor and remains actively involved with the Leukemia and Lymphoma Society (now Blood Cancer United), including fundraising and endurance events with Team in Training.

To discuss the specifics of your case with Tulsa business attorney Jared Nelson, call (918) 928-7104 or schedule a consultation via the online contact form.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Chad Neuens is a licensed member of the State Bars of Oklahoma, Texas and Colorado, and is admitted to practice before several Federal Bars, including The United States Supreme Court. He has tried over 50 jury trials to verdict in both federal and state courts throughout the country, representing both plaintiffs and defendants, with a 90 percent success rate. He has also tried numerous non-jury trials and arbitrations. In addition, Chad is an experienced mediator and is a member of the mediator panel at Dispute Resolution Consultants.

Chad earned his Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance from the University of Oklahoma.

He earned his Doctor of Jurisprudence from Creighton University School of Law, where he served as an Editor of the Creighton Law Review.

Chad has over 35 years of experience in the areas of product liability, construction, trucking, transportation, premises liability, wrongful death, personal injury, fire and explosion, civil rights, subrogation, environmental liability, oil and gas, fraud, toxic tort, commercial litigation, law enforcement, business litigation, banking, and mediator/alternative dispute resolution. He has presented several seminars in these areas.

attorneys.name: Drew Nichols
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law (Divorce, Paternity, Custody, Child Support) Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Drew Nichols is an experienced trial attorney in the areas of family, criminal and civil law. He spent the initial years of his legal career as a prosecutor for District 21 serving the people of Cleveland, Garvin and McClain County. He didn’t waste anytime getting into the courtroom and handled his first jury trial only a few months after getting sworn in. While a prosecutor, Drew handled a variety of cases with a primary focus on drug prosecutions. He maintained one of the highest caseloads in the District Attorney’s Office with an average of more than 250 cases being prosecuted at any given time. Drew’s time as a prosecutor provided him with the unique advantage of being in the courtroom on an almost daily basis. In 2004, Drew started his own law practice and hasn’t looked back.

Since leaving the DA’s office, Drew has expanded his knowledge and practice of the law in many areas including personal injury and general civil litigation. He has achieved fantastic results for hundreds of individuals facing serious crimes. He has successfully litigated and resolved almost every type of family law matter. His family law cases often involve complicated asset division and highly contested custody matters. In essence, Drew does it all and he does it all well.

Drew is meticulous, organized, personable, aggressive, patient and caring. He is well known within the community and the State of Oklahoma. He cares about his clients and takes on their troubles as if they are his own.

Drew has served as a speaker on behalf of the Oklahoma Bar Association to other Oklahoma attorneys. He has returned to OU Law School many times to serve as a guest judge for current students and has addressed local schoolchildren on the law and it’s role in our society.

Outside the office, Drew enjoys spending time with his wife and their three children. He is involved in his church and enjoys serving as the large group leader teaching Sunday school to Kindergartners thru 5th Graders. His other interests include exercising, hiking, movies, college sports and the Oklahoma City Thunder.

attorneys.name: Glendell D. Nix
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Background

Glendell D. Nix grew up in Broken Bow, Oklahoma. Glendell enjoyed rather unusual experiences and disciplines in his early years. Beginning at the age of 11 to 18 he was a self-taught juggler, unicyclist and tightrope walker, spending hours a day devoted to his passion. At the age of 12 he began performing his juggling, unicycle and tightrope walking act in front of small audiences as well as large audiences of thousands at events across Oklahoma. He enjoyed the challenge and discipline required. Even though Glendell had an interest in his unique discipline, he always maintained his love for academics and speech competition. While in high school he competed in speech competitions across the state, winning many awards in contemporary speaking, oration, prose and drama. In 1982, he graduated valedictorian of his high school class. His parents, a business owner/auto mechanic and stay-at-home mom, were his biggest supporters and taught hard work and discipline as the key to enjoying life and contributing to others' lives.

attorneys.name: Drew Palmer
attorneys.practice_type: Intellectual Property Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Drew Palmer is a distinguished intellectual property attorney and compliance professional with a robust career spanning multiple industries, including software, cybersecurity, technology transactions, employment law, and sustainability initiatives. Based in Edmond, OK, Drew has built a reputation for helping businesses navigate complex legal and compliance challenges, particularly those involving technology.

Professional Background

Drew represents clients in intellectual property litigation, covering patent, trademark, and copyright infringement matters. His keen understanding of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, data privacy, and cybersecurity allows him to provide insightful legal advice and risk assessments to clients, ensuring their business operations remain compliant and secure.

In addition to his role as a private practice attorney, Drew has previously served as associate general counsel, IT Director, Chief Information Security Officer and chief ethics counsel. Drew's experience in developing and implementing enterprise-wide IT policies, standards, procedures, and best practices, as well as conducting privileged internal investigations has significantly improved operational outcomes and reduced enterprise risks. He was instrumental in developing and supervising a multi-state COVID-19 infection prevention plan, managing the ethics and compliance program, and drafting an inaugural Sustainability Report.

Drew has handled multi-million dollar software and SaaS license audits, prepared and prosecuted patent applications, and represented clients in intellectual property infringement and misappropriation cases. Drew's notable achievements include winning a seminal case regarding copyright infringement in the software industry before the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals.

attorneys.name: Blake Parrott
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Blake Parrott is the Managing Attorney with the firm in the Oklahoma City location. He attended the University of Oklahoma, earning a Bachelor of Business Administration with an emphasis in Marketing in 1996. Blake graduated from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2000.

Blake is licensed in both Oklahoma (2000) and California (2023). He is also licensed to practice before the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Oklahoma, the United States District Court for the Northern District of Oklahoma, the United States District Court for the Western District of Oklahoma, the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Western District of Oklahoma, the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, the United States Bankruptcy Appellate Panel for the Tenth Circuit, the Choctaw Nation, and the Muscogee (Creek) Nation. He is also a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association, the California Bar Association, the Oklahoma County Bar Association, the American Bar Association, the Choctaw Nation Bar Association, and the Muscogee (Creek) Nation Bar Association.

Since 2000, Blake’s practice has primarily consisted of banking and financial institution litigation, real estate litigation, title insurance defense, and commercial and residential evictions. Blake also has extensive appellate experience, with six reported cases in the area of mortgage foreclosure and title related issues.

Blake has been a frequent speaker at continuing legal education programs on real estate, mortgage banking and servicing, and title insurance relating topics, most recently speaking at the 2024 Oklahoma Judicial Conference Annual Meeting on the topic of “avoiding land mines and reversals in judicial foreclosures.” He is also currently recognized as a Best Lawyer in America in the practice areas of Finance, Banking and Finance Litigation, and Real Estate Litigation.

attorneys.name: J. Patrick Quillian
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
J. Patrick Quillian is a former Oklahoma district attorney who prides himself on the quality of legal advice and performance he brings to his clients. He makes a point of being readily accessible and demonstrating zealous representation during all phases of a case.

When he was a prosecutor, Mr. Quillian tried numerous felony cases and argued before both the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals as well as the Oklahoma Supreme Court Referee.

Since shifting his practice to criminal defense, Mr. Quillian has procured verdicts of not guilty for clients in municipal, state and federal courts. It is his mission to lend an aggressive and informed legal hand to clients of all social classes and economic backgrounds — from the most sophisticated and business savvy entrepreneur to everyday people in need of assistance and representation.

He works hard, with combination of dynamic skills, personal understanding and sensitivity, to help you put whatever legal issues are facing behind you as efficiently and painlessly as possible.

Mr. Quillian is passionate about the law and serving his state and community. He is an executive member of the Robert J. Turner American Inn of Court, an association established to “foster excellence in professionalism, ethics, civility, and legal skills for judges, lawyers, academicians, and students of law in order to perfect the quality, availability, and efficiency of justice in the United States.”

attorneys.name: Randa K. Reeves
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Litigation Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Randa K. Reeves was admitted to the Oklahoma Bar in 2011. She is admitted to practice law before the Northeastern and Western Districts of Oklahoma. Randa received her B.A. with distinction from the University of Oklahoma in 2008 and her J.D. from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2011, with honors. She is the recipient of the American Indian Law Review Am Jur Award for Legal Research and Writing and Civil Procedure II and was recognized as having the highest score in her class.

Randa was named by the Oklahoma Bar Association as the Outstanding First Year Law Student in 2008, and a Top 10 Outstanding Graduating Criminology Student. Randa is a member of the Bryant County and Oklahoma County Bar Associations, Oklahoma Association for Justice (OAJ), Oklahoma Lawyers Care, and the American Association for Justice, Luther Bohanon American Inn of Court XXIII.

Randa was appointed to the OAJ Advisory Board in 2015 and the CLE Committee in 2014. She is a 2013 OAJ recipient of the President's Award for contributions as a founding member of Oklahoma Lawyers Care, a group formed to provide aid following the devastating tornados in May 2013. Randa recently helped try a precedent setting case, the first product liability case to be tried against an energy drink company in the United States. She has also served as the second chair trial lawyer on many significant multi-million dollar civil cases, taken trial depositions, and written, responded to and argued a large variety of complex motions.

Randa is from Atoka, Oklahoma, and a valedictorian graduate of Atoka High School.

He has served as lead attorney on over 75 jury trials to date all across the state of Oklahoma. He also serves as an instructor for other attorneys in continuing legal education seminars.

K. Ellis Ritchie earned his Juris Doctorate Degree from the University Of Tulsa College Of Law in Tulsa, Oklahoma in 1992. In 1993 he founded his own law firm which has grown into the present firm of “Ritchie, Rock & McBride”.

He has served as President of the local Bar Association and is admitted to the United States Supreme Court Bar, all Oklahoma state courts and federal courts located in the state, Oklahoma Bar Association and the Mayes County Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Alison Roberts
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Alison is a native of Fort Worth, Texas, and received her undergraduate degree from Oklahoma Christian University. She graduated Cum Laude from Oklahoma City University Law School, where she served as a staff member and senior member of the OCU Law Review and a contributing editor to the Oklahoma District Court Judges' Civil Bench Book.

While at OCU Law, Alison was selected as a summer law clerk for the United States Attorney's Office for the Western District of Oklahoma. She then interned at the Oklahoma County District Attorney's Office where she was hired upon graduation. As an Oklahoma County Assistant District Attorney Alison began her career with a large misdemeanor docket as well as felony revocations. She was soon promoted to felonies where she spent two years handling a general felony docket. A majority of these cases involved drug offenses including Possession with Intent to Distribute and Trafficking. Alison also prosecuted a handful of violent offenses including murder and manslaughter.

attorneys.name: Faye C Rodgers
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Edmond, OK
attorneys.bio:
Faye C. Rodgers is a native of Houston, Texas. She attended Texas A&M University for her bachelor's degree. She has been a resident of Oklahoma since she moved to attend Oklahoma City University School of Law. While obtaining her law degree, Faye was an active officer in the Sports and Entertainment Law Association and served as a Senior Student Ambassador. Faye also participated an internship program with the Oklahoma Legal Aid Family Law division.

Since being admitted to the Oklahoma Bar, Faye continued her education by obtaining her MBA degree from the University of Central Oklahoma. Further, Faye is active within several legal organizations. Faye is a board member of the Young Lawyers Division of the Oklahoma County Bar Association. Additionally, Faye is a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association Family Law section and a member of the Ruth Bader Ginsburg American Inn of Court.

Family law continues to be Faye's passion. She is committed to helping individuals successfully address family issues and solve matters in a respectful and dignified manner that minimizes the effects on children. Faye understands the very private and personal nature of family law and prides herself on being sensitive to such issues. Faye uses her experience and unique skill set to assist clients during what is likely a difficult and stressful time in the client's life, and it is her goal to do so in the manner most likely to preserve family relationships and to be least harmful to children.

In her spare time, Faye enjoys traveling, event planning and is an active member of the Oklahoma City Texas A&M Club.

attorneys.name: Scott Ryan
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Tulsa, OK
attorneys.bio:
Scott Ryan was born in Havre De Grace, Maryland in 1965. He graduated from the University of Oklahoma with a Bachelor's degree in 1987 and he earned his Juris Doctorate degree from the University of Oklahoma in 1991. Mr. Ryan served in the United States Army, both on active duty and National Guard and JAG Reserves. He has already served one tour of duty in Iraq and was recently redeployed for a second tour.

Mr. Ryan was admitted to the Oklahoma Bar Association in 1991, and he is admitted to practice in all state and federal district courts in Oklahoma and the U.S. Court of Appeals, Tenth Circuit. He is a member of the Oklahoma Bar Association and the Oklahoma Association of Defense Counsel. He has also attended the Defense Counsel Trial Academy and he is on the Board of Directors of the Oklahoma Association of Defense Counsel.

After graduating from law school, Mr. Ryan came to work for the predecessor to Taylor, Ryan, Schmidt & Van Dalsem, P.C., and has worked there as a trial attorney ever since. His practice areas include negligence, products liability, construction disputes and insurance disputes. Recently, he has been heavily involved in defense of E.I.F.S. and mold litigation. He has also practiced in the area of professional malpractice defense, including defending optometrists and insurance agents. He has completed approximately 85 civil jury trials as lead counsel in state, federal and military courts. He has been lead counsel in bad faith litigation involving claims for medical payments and uninsured motorist benefits.

John Scott Sanders was raised in Poteau, Oklahoma. John has two older brothers and one younger sister. In his free time, John enjoys playing golf, going to the movies, and attending various sporting events. John has been with Whitten Burrage since the summer of 2019.

attorneys.name: Patricia Sawyer
attorneys.practice_type: Tribal Nation Law Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Patricia is a highly experienced attorney offering comprehensive expertise in both transactional and litigation matters. Patricia has had the privilege of working alongside Michael Burrage for a decade. This invaluable experience provided an opportunity for growth and learning from a legend known for his brilliant legal career and exceptional reputation. Under Michael's mentorship Patricia honed her legal skills, gained profound insights into the intricacies of the law, and developed a comprehensive understanding of the nuances that shape the legal landscape. The guidance and knowledge imparted by Michael continues to inspire Patricia as she navigates complex legal matters and strives to provide unparalleled legal representations to clients.

Before joining Whitten Burrage, Patricia worked as a staff attorney at the OU Health Sciences Center ("OUHSC") where she served as primary counsel for the College of Nursing, College of Public Health, and College of Allied Heath. Her work at OUHSC focused on healthcare law, regulatory compliance, healthcare acquisitions, and contract law. Before law school Patricia was a registered nurse practicing in one of the most stressful and important settings, a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.

During Patricia's time at Whitten Burrage, a large part of her practice is focused on Tribal Nations law. Patricia's deep understanding of the unique legal considerations and cultural dynamics involved in Tribal Nations law has earned her the trust and respect of tribal clients and peers alike. Through diligent advocacy, Patricia has worked to protect and promote tribal sovereignty, navigate complex jurisdictional issues, and ensure the preservation of treaty rights. Patricia is always happy to speak with other tribal attorneys to share and exchange ideas to promote and protect tribal rights.

Patricia has represented her primary tribal clients, the Chickasaw and Choctaw Nations, in matters before regulatory agencies, and in state and federal courts. Patricia strikes a balance between collaboration and assertiveness, utilizing negotiation skills to build productive relationships and achieve favorable outcomes. She tackles conflicts when they arise, leveraging her expertise and determination to protect and advance her clients' rights and interests.

Patricia also represents numerous clients in private, corporate transactional law and litigation. Patricia was a member of the legal team that successfully litigated a divorce with assets in the billions of dollars. Many of these clients often return for future legal matters, a testament to the exceptional service and positive outcomes she consistently delivers.

Patricia has garnered a reputation for excellence and integrity. Her track record of success, coupled with the trust and loyalty of clients, has solidified her position as a sought-after advocate in the legal field.

attorneys.name: Debbie L. Self
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Self was on the President’s and Dean’s Honor Rolls at the University of Oklahoma where she earned her Juris Doctorate in Law and her Bachelor of Arts in Public Affairs and Administration. She also studied law at Oxford University in the United Kingdom. Ms. Self was a member of the honor legal fraternity, Phi Delta Phi, and was the pledge class president of her sorority in undergraduate school. Ms. Self is named in “Who’s Who: American Law Students.”

While attending law school, Ms. Self owned and operated her own business, while at the same time working as a judicial law clerk, and later as a criminal prosecutor with the Oklahoma County District Attorney’s office. As a law clerk, Ms. Self researched and prepared judicial opinions for administrative and criminal appeals. At the District Attorney’s office, she litigated negligent homicides, DUIs, probation violations, and white collar crimes.

Ms. Self later became an Assistant Attorney General where she worked on complex multi-state antitrust, bankruptcy, telecommunications, consumer fraud, and white collar fraud litigation. Ms. Self served as lead counsel for the 26-state National Association of Attorneys General working group in the WorldCom bankruptcy in New York, and the related criminal prosecution of WorldCom in Oklahoma state courts. She also served on the Oklahoma Inter-Agency Bankruptcy Fraud Task Force comprised of officials from the IRS, FBI, DEA and other law enforcement agencies. While on the Leadership Council of the National Association of Attorneys General multi-state insurance group, she helped draft legislation which shaped the National Association of Insurance Commissioners interstate insurance licensing compact. Ms. Self served as liaison with the Oklahoma Department of Insurance for various matters of consumer interest, and on many multi-state working groups and legal teams which revolutionized consumer rights in the wireless, telemarketing and telecommunications industries.

Before opening her own practice, Ms. Self practiced with an insurance and entertainment law firm in Nashville and served for many years as the Chief Legal Counsel (General Counsel) to nationwide insurance and medical management companies with employees and operations throughout the United States. She most recently served as Chief Counsel for Claimetrics, a division of Express Employment Professionals – the nation’s largest privately held temporary staffing agency with over 300,000 employees in 50 states and four countries. Additionally, she headed up the legal departments at Humana Workers’ Compensation Services, PCA Solutions, Hallmark Management, and Sterling Dental Services.

Business start-ups, operations, licensing and regulatory compliance are key components of her practice. Throughout her career, Ms. Self has acquired thousands of business, professional and insurance licenses on behalf of her clients. She has also been licensed as an insurance agent, adjuster, third party administrator and managing general agent in her own right.

As the Chief Legal Counsel to several start-up companies, she architected the legal departments from the ground up. While leading these legal departments, she also directed the Compliance, Human Resources and Risk Management departments from time to time. As a result, she developed a wealth of experience in employment, insurance, medical management and regulatory law. She has represented numerous employers and employees in unemployment benefit hearings, labor board hearings, drafting employee handbooks, developing employee benefit plans, ERISA law, EEOC claims and employment discrimination litigation.

She is now the owner and operator of Self Legal Group, PLLC, a business, estate planning, family law and civil litigation firm in Oklahoma City.

As an aggressive advocate for individual rights, Ms. Self also concentrates on providing legal services to individuals in the areas of business law, civil litigation, family and estate planning matters. Because of her vast background in business and insurance law, Ms. Self is often called upon to handle such matters for business owners, medical professionals and individual clients with complex legal needs.

sections.content:
Ms. Self was on the President’s and Dean’s Honor Rolls at the University of Oklahoma where she earned her Juris Doctorate in Law and her Bachelor of Arts in Public Affairs and Administration. She also studied law at Oxford University in the United Kingdom. Ms. Self was a member of the honor legal fraternity, Phi Delta Phi, and was the pledge class president of her sorority in undergraduate school. Ms. Self is named in “Who’s Who: American Law Students.”

While attending law school, Ms. Self owned and operated her own business, while at the same time working as a judicial law clerk, and later as a criminal prosecutor with the Oklahoma County District Attorney’s office. As a law clerk, Ms. Self researched and prepared judicial opinions for administrative and criminal appeals. At the District Attorney’s office, she litigated negligent homicides, DUIs, probation violations, and white collar crimes.

Ms. Self later became an Assistant Attorney General where she worked on complex multi-state antitrust, bankruptcy, telecommunications, consumer fraud, and white collar fraud litigation. Ms. Self served as lead counsel for the 26-state National Association of Attorneys General working group in the WorldCom bankruptcy in New York, and the related criminal prosecution of WorldCom in Oklahoma state courts. She also served on the Oklahoma Inter-Agency Bankruptcy Fraud Task Force comprised of officials from the IRS, FBI, DEA and other law enforcement agencies. While on the Leadership Council of the National Association of Attorneys General multi-state insurance group, she helped draft legislation which shaped the National Association of Insurance Commissioners interstate insurance licensing compact. Ms. Self served as liaison with the Oklahoma Department of Insurance for various matters of consumer interest, and on many multi-state working groups and legal teams which revolutionized consumer rights in the wireless, telemarketing and telecommunications industries.

Before opening her own practice, Ms. Self practiced with an insurance and entertainment law firm in Nashville and served for many years as the Chief Legal Counsel (General Counsel) to nationwide insurance and medical management companies with employees and operations throughout the United States. She most recently served as Chief Counsel for Claimetrics, a division of Express Employment Professionals – the nation’s largest privately held temporary staffing agency with over 300,000 employees in 50 states and four countries. Additionally, she headed up the legal departments at Humana Workers’ Compensation Services, PCA Solutions, Hallmark Management, and Sterling Dental Services.

Business start-ups, operations, licensing and regulatory compliance are key components of her practice. Throughout her career, Ms. Self has acquired thousands of business, professional and insurance licenses on behalf of her clients. She has also been licensed as an insurance agent, adjuster, third party administrator and managing general agent in her own right.

As the Chief Legal Counsel to several start-up companies, she architected the legal departments from the ground up. While leading these legal departments, she also directed the Compliance, Human Resources and Risk Management departments from time to time. As a result, she developed a wealth of experience in employment, insurance, medical management and regulatory law. She has represented numerous employers and employees in unemployment benefit hearings, labor board hearings, drafting employee handbooks, developing employee benefit plans, ERISA law, EEOC claims and employment discrimination litigation.

She is now the owner and operator of Self Legal Group, PLLC, a business, estate planning, family law and civil litigation firm in Oklahoma City.

As an aggressive advocate for individual rights, Ms. Self also concentrates on providing legal services to individuals in the areas of business law, civil litigation, family and estate planning matters. Because of her vast background in business and insurance law, Ms. Self is often called upon to handle such matters for business owners, medical professionals and individual clients with complex legal needs.

attorneys.name: Pete G. Serrata III
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Coverage Litigation Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Pete G. Serrata III began his legal career at as an associate attorney at Derryberry & Naifeh, L.L.P. under the tutelage of Bob Naifeh, Doug Rice and Larry Derryberry. Concentrating in the areas of insurance coverage, commercial litigation, and administrative law and utilities regulation, Pete has expanded his practice to include antitrust and veteran’s services.

Pete received his B.A. degree in Political Science in 2001 from the University of North Texas. In 2001, Pete was selected to receive the prestigious Hatton W. Sumners Foundation legal scholarship to attend the Oklahoma City University School of Law. After his military unit was recalled to service following the attacks of September 11th, Pete returned to Oklahoma City University where he completed his J.D. in 2006 graduating first in his class.

After practicing with the Firm from 2006 to 2012, Pete returned to the Oklahoma City University School of Law to serve as the Assistant Dean for Law Career Services. In addition to mentoring and preparing new professionals for careers in the legal practice, Pete practiced in the Law School’s pro bono projects and served on the adjunct faculty teaching courses in the Uniform Commercial Code, Pretrial Litigation and the Law of War.

Pete returned to Derryberry & Naifeh, L.L.P. in 2018 where he practices in the areas of insurance coverage, commercial litigation, administrative law, and public utilities regulation. In addition to more than a decade of experience as an attorney, Pete brings nearly eight years of experience as a non-commissioned officer in the U.S. Army where he served in the areas of counter intelligence, counter terrorism and strategic investigations. Pete is admitted before the Oklahoma Supreme Court, all Oklahoma Federal Courts, the Tenth Circuit U.S. Court of Appeals, and the U.S. Supreme Court.

attorneys.name: Matt Shelton
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Matt Shelton was born and raised in Kansas City, MO from a working-class family of firefighters. After playing college soccer for Baker University in Kansas, he moved to Oklahoma to pursue the practice of law and has lived here ever since.

Matt earned his Juris Doctorate in Law at the University of Oklahoma City School of Law. While attending law school he externed for multiple Oklahoma County District Judges and was employed to intern on many various civil litigation matters.

After passing the bar, Matt began his career practicing complex civil litigation issues that involved representing plaintiffs in federal employment discrimination cases and/or compliance disputes regarding businesses and transactions.

Matt later became an Assistant Attorney General for the State of Oklahoma where he defended civil lawsuits against the State. While at the OAG's Office, he managed a high-volume caseload involving personal injury, property law, collections, and employment law.

Immediately preceding his career with Self Legal Group, PLLC, Matt worked for a high-volume corporate law firm specifically handling family law matters. He is now an Associate Attorney here at SLG practicing family law, civil litigation, estate planning, bankruptcy, and collections.

When Matt isn’t practicing law, he enjoys traveling to the mountains to ski, fly fishing, and playing/watching sports.

attorneys.bio:

Recognized by Super Lawyers as a Rising Star from 2022 to present, A.J. has experience litigating in state and federal courts in Oklahoma. A.J. represents companies and individuals alike in matters covering a broad spectrum, including, for example: commercial litigation, general civil litigation, business litigation, insurance defense, construction litigation, landlord-tenant issues, business matters and real estate litigation.

A.J.’s training in business and finance has been invaluable in the complicated process of advising clients on business and litigation risks as well as analyzing and assessing damages.

attorneys.name: Blake Sonne
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Blake is a native of southern California who came to Oklahoma on a basketball scholarship where he played two years for Northern Oklahoma College. Blake then played Division I basketball at Marist College in Poughkeepsie, New York. He earned his B.S. in Business Management, summa cum laude, in 2001 from Marist College. While at Marist, he served as Team Captain, was selected as a NCAA Academic All-American and finished his career in the top 10 in 3 Point Shooting FG% and 3FG Made in Marist basketball history.

Following his time at Marist, Blake returned to Oklahoma and earned his J.D. from the University of Oklahoma College of Law, with highest honors. During law school, he was a Comfort Scholar, graduated Order of the Coif, and served as Note Editor on the Editorial Board of the Oklahoma Law Review. Following law school, Blake worked for McAfee & Taft, Oklahoma’s largest law firm.

Since 2006, Blake has owned and operated his own civil litigation law firm in Norman, OK. Blake is an experienced trial lawyer who has tried numerous cases in state and federal court as well as over 60 administrative trials. Blake’s litigation practice focuses on consumer law, insurance bad faith, personal injury, complex commercial and business disputes, labor and employment law, fraud, and securities litigation. In his last four jury trials in Cleveland County, Blake secured an award of punitive damages for his clients.

Blake is admitted to practice law before the Oklahoma Supreme Court, the Western District of Oklahoma, the Northern District of Oklahoma, the Eastern District of Oklahoma, and the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals. He resides in Norman with his wife T.J., a native Oklahoman, and their six children.

attorneys.name: Heather Strohmeyer
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Litigation Lawyers in Oklahoma City, OK
attorneys.bio:
Heather is a lifelong resident of Oklahoma from Purcell, Oklahoma. She received her Juris Doctorate, with Distinction, from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2011, was admitted to the Oklahoma State Bar in 2011 and is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Western and Eastern Districts.

While at OU law, Heather earned the Am-Jur Award for Torts II in 2009 for receiving the highest score in her class and was a member of the American Indian Law Review. Prior to law school, Heather graduated from the University of Oklahoma in 2008 with a B.A. in Letters.

Heather has extensive litigation experience representing Plaintiffs in wrongful death, personal injury, premises liability, insurance bad faith, and product liability lawsuits. She has also been part of litigation teams in other complex litigation and class action suits. Before joining Whitten Burrage, she gained extensive experience in civil, administrative, criminal and family law. One of her more notable cases before joining Whitten Burrage was acting as co-lead counsel in a successful Section 1983 suit against the City of Oklahoma City in which she obtained a ruling deeming the city's Sign Code facially unconstitutional. She has first and second chaired numerous bench and jury trials, conducted a variety of evidentiary hearings, briefed and argued complex motions, prosecuted and defended civil and criminal appeals, and taken and defended trial depositions.

During her tenure at Whitten Burrage, Heather has contributed to recovering multi-million-dollar settlements for her clients, including many six and seven figure wrongful death, insurance bad faith and personal injury settlements.

Heather is a member of the Oklahoma Association for Justice, Oklahoma Bar Association, and the Cleveland County Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Matt Swain
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Norman, OK
attorneys.bio:
Criminal Defense Attorney Matt Swain grew up with a passion for the law and a commitment to justice. As an attorney, his commitment to helping people through the most difficult times they may ever face is evident in the personal, one-on-one attention he provides to each client. He is involved in each and every case, from the initial intake to the strategy sessions, to the final client meetings. Mr. Swain works to ensure his clients understand all their options and how their case is progressing. He always returns phone calls and emails promptly because he understands the stress and anxiety that comes with being either a plaintiff in a civil case or a defendant in a criminal case.

Matt Swain received his undergraduate degree from Wake Forest University and his law degree from the University of Oklahoma. During his time at the University of Oklahoma, Mr. Swain spent a year interning at the Oklahoma County District Attorney's Office, spending time in both the White Collar Division and on one of the General Felony teams. This experience allowed him to handle plea negotiations, preliminary hearings, and trials, under the tutelage of experienced prosecutors...many of whom are still prosecutors in Oklahoma County or are currently Oklahoma County Judges.

After graduating from law school and passing the Oklahoma Bar, Mr. Swain founded the Swain Law Group. What started as a one man operation has grown into a highly successful practice featuring 14 attorneys with tremendous experience in many different practices areas.
